subject: My reflections on our work in 2024
body:
I am so proud of all that we have accomplished as a community.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99548233/520234712/664783965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYWQ5ZDAyOS0wYWM3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDIyNDgyYTkzYWYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bNDODECchzKpYGeLfhk5CTvJt-uIb_vi7Gr_Cp3iHfc=&emci=b054f883-c5bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=1ad9d029-0ac7-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=864787)
Dear Peter,
It’s been a tumultuous year for the care agenda, but we’ve met each challenge with tremendous energy and support from our volunteers and members.
**I am so proud of all that we have accomplished as a community.** In the lead-up to the 2024 election, we mobilized thousands of volunteers across vital swing states to get out the vote for care. We elected Care Champions like Josh Stein, Jacky Rosen, and Ruben Gallego as well as in important down-ballot races, showing the power of our care constituency.
Our community will face challenges in the coming years — the incoming administration poses serious threats to immigrant communities, working families, and critical care programs like Medicaid.******But, we are prepared to protect our communities and fight back against every proposed cut to care.****** We’ve put together our legislative agenda for the coming year, and along with our sister organization, the National Domestic Workers Alliance, we will use every tool available to fight attacks on immigrants and critical care programs.
In these uncertain times, **finding strength in community is imperative.** There is nothing we cannot accomplish together, but protecting the care agenda from an onslaught of efforts to attack and disenfranchise the most vulnerable members of our communities******is going to take all of us.**
In the coming weeks and months, we will be sharing more ways to get involved with our work at Care in Action to protect health care access and support our community in the first 100 days of Trump’s administration.
I encourage you to forward these emails to family members and friends who may not know about the work we do. **We are only as strong as our community, and we will grow stronger with each new caregiver and ally who joins us.**
Wishing you a happy, healthy, and safe New Year,
Hillary Holley
Executive Director | Care in Action

Dear Friend,

You know that most institutions of higher education have been hotbeds of anti-Americanism for decades.

In recent years, the radical ideologies hatched in higher education have spread into the mainstream of American life.

The need to push back aggressively has become urgent.

Next year, we must do even more for the cause of liberty and the American way of life. And I think the opportunities are significantly better than in the past.

**We must do all we can to revive and preserve the principles and practices of liberty and limited constitutional government on the battlefield of education. **

Hillsdale College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this crucial time for our nation.

That's why we have set a goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty Through Education** in 2025.

The focus of this vital project is to foster informed patriotism nationwide, especially among younger Americans. And we need your help.

**[Before the end of 2024, would you consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift? We have set a goal to raise $6,000,000 from our friends nationwide by December 31](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2cc3f55b33c9493cbc115d8c63dd8f74&_e=xj9oMBb583U5gObqkH60wpfyMWnWxdJLzv31OQGHl7F3F8Cq4WriqiXHr6GkBKTQeWiEFBNGNQ0N2PPvKmXu2T7psohY8DJfyfoC7JYiWXPXgaaTJFXB43nDCBe1tbvmqqFIxe_T61JDSIAJgOn8umb937EtwobyOawAvyyWQxZnEZpLyzVVbikIxZY60pkD9DJz3nCkZvf0u9Cj2LGCMWAxiWRdgFZzuFpeHPhwa3BU1Rq0FLKpLMdzuvua9pxHj_aXX48rqulF-xSBeVCeIv5ANdN1GRpZuES3K_9wcWW0JCS44WauyV317kImWIewiZqrXjtWYSGzOXaAlosijVUZf-_UMyn8KVqoPgDVGLii7KF5V8yffU2XvE7NcZPf).**

Hillsdale's educational outreach on behalf of liberty has never been more urgent than it is today. That's because efforts to undermine patriotism and destroy the American way of life have been increasing--with the ultimate goal of transforming American government and society.

Your year-end gift will help us to promote informed patriotism by educating millions of Americans--especially younger Americans--about our nation's great heritage of liberty.

One way we accomplish this is through our free online courses--courses such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "Land of Hope: The Great American Story," and "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

**We must increase the number of citizens we reach and teach through these free online courses, as well as through our several other educational outreach efforts --efforts such as _Imprimis_ and our ongoing work to help launch and support Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 charter schools nationwide. **

**Defeating the anti-American Left on the battlefield of education is an essential part of reviving and preserving the American way of life.**

Hillsdale College refuses to accept even one penny of government support--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. _This principled independence frees us from many burdensome and corrupting federal regulations and allows us to remain true to our mission._

It also means that we depend entirely on the support of citizens like you.

**I see the tremendous impact of this support as I travel around the nation and talk to those who benefit from Hillsdale 's educational outreach. It is especially gratifying to see the impact on younger Americans.**

Your year-end contribution will help us expand Hillsdale's educational outreach on behalf of liberty in 2025.

If you agree that it is vitally important to promote informed patriotism by educating increasing millions of citizens (especially younger Americans) about our nation's great heritage of liberty, please make your best tax-deductible gift to Hillsdale College by December 31.

**You can give your year-end tax-deductible gift using this secure link:**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2cc3f55b33c9493cbc115d8c63dd8f74&_e=xj9oMBb583U5gObqkH60wpfyMWnWxdJLzv31OQGHl7F3F8Cq4WriqiXHr6GkBKTQeWiEFBNGNQ0N2PPvKmXu2T7psohY8DJfyfoC7JYiWXPXgaaTJFXB43nDCBe1tbvmqqFIxe_T61JDSIAJgOn8umb937EtwobyOawAvyyWQxZnEZpLyzVVbikIxZY60pkD9DJz3nCkZvf0u9Cj2LGCMeO8g7zHF9HzXyT4nLV1X8MLHjF1T36saFoGEAPxPy4HBuDnm_zKOe3lyJ8TXTqNT1lf6eb1tF15Fsm0Dn-_YuuX3ablWtC2JuQ21lKAbu2KQ8s4vF0NmW17cUVCp0yd_k0MmgT8Ilo6FhgJxsFi3eLsbc4GhI7yWqdKpxxcT6mv)

We are honored by your partnership in the crucial year ahead.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Hi there Friend, ____ As the year draws to a close, it's natural to reflect on the journey we've had--and what we look forward to the new year ahead. What kind of growth do you want to experience in your prayer life and your relationship with God in 2025? Maybe you want to start your day focused on His Word or end it by reflecting on His promises. Whatever that growth looks like for you, there's no better time than now to set the course for a deeper walk with God in the year ahead.

That's why I'm excited to share a resource that could be a powerful tool for your spiritual growth this coming year: **_Today in the Word_** , a daily devotional from the Moody Bible Institute. This is one of my favorite ways to engage with Scripture each day, and I believe it could be a great way for you to center your heart and grow in your prayer life throughout the year.

You might be wondering, "What makes _Today in the Word_ daily devotionals so special?"

Each devotional is written by the esteemed professors of Moody Bible Institute, who bring decades of wisdom and a deep love for God's Word to their writing. Their insights not only encourage you but also challenge you to apply God's truth to your everyday life.

By signing up for **_Today in the Word_** , you'll receive a fresh devotional delivered straight to your inbox every morning, helping you start your day with biblical wisdom and a renewed sense of purpose. We read complete books of the Bible and explore biblical topics that encourage your faith journey.

Over a million readers already rely on **_Today in the Word_** to guide them in their walk with the Lord--and I believe it can help you experience growth in your spiritual life, too.

**Are you ready to make 2025 a year of deeper prayer, reflection, and growth in your relationship with God?**

Sign up now at the link below, and let's start this new year together in God's Word.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Something better:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
The odds may be stacked against us, but that doesn't mean we don’t try.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS)
---
Thinking ahead towards the new year and the start of the second Trump administration, we have two choices in front of us. We can accept a corrupt, greedy administration for what it is, surrender our country to Project 2025, and legitimize a government that works for billionaires and corporations. Or we can do everything we possibly can to throw a wrench in their plans, use the tools we have to prevent or minimize their damage, and keep up the fight for something better. I know what choice I’m making. And I need you with me. The odds may be stacked against us, but that doesn't mean we don’t try. And that doesn’t mean we can’t win. For example, even when Republicans controlled the House, the Senate, and the White House back in 2017, they were hellbent on rolling back health care access. But brave activists — who put their bodies on the line in the halls of Congress — and a nationwide grassroots campaign fought and won to preserve the Affordable Care Act. We stopped them. You don’t get what you don’t fight for. [**In 2025, I’ll keep you updated on the fights to come as we face new opportunities to push back against harmful policies and press forward for positive change. And if it makes sense for you right now, I’m asking if you can make a donation to support our campaign before the next FEC deadline to raise the resources we need to do this work and demonstrate how many people like you are still in this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2885?t=8&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS)

---
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_ |
---
| [DONATE NOW: $3](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2885?t=22&express_lane=true&amount=3&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS)

---
| [DONATE NOW: $100](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2885?t=18&express_lane=true&amount=100&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS)
---
| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2885?t=20&express_lane=true&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS)
---

---
Before the administration begins, we already see why we need to stay in the fight — and I understand my assignment as a U.S. senator. That’s why I’ll keep shining a light on the conflicts of interest between Elon Musk being co-president and also being the richest man in the world — and fighting for proper oversight. That’s why I’ll keep pointing out Trump’s broken promises: How he said he will lower costs for families before the election, and then told his rich buddies, “We're cutting your taxes — we're going to cut them very substantially" after the election. That’s why I’ll be fighting back against any attempt by the administration to privatize public goods like the USPS. That’s why if Republicans go forward with more tax breaks for billionaires and billionaire corporations, I’m going to push back every inch of the way. That’s why I’ll keep defending the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau against the big banks who want free rein to rip off the American people. That’s why I’ve recently re-introduced my Accountable Capitalism Act to shift corporations away from maximizing shareholder value to support for workers and communities. But I’m also asking you to stay in the fight, because I can’t do all this alone. I’m asking you to remember your power. The far right wants us to roll over and accept defeat. No. [**We’ve got our work cut out for us, but I know this movement is going to keep up the fight no matter what. If you’re with us, can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can before tomorrow’s FEC deadline to ensure we can start 2025 — and a second Trump administration — with the strongest support possible?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2885?amount=28&t=14&akid=2437%2E4032634%2EVeV0mS) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

But for you to be informed about what's going on, to know which candidates are going to stand up for you, to know what bills are putting your rights under threat, our work is critically important.
Please, fuel our fight to protect our right to vote and increase participation in our elections with $25 or whatever you can before midnight tomorrow >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=123024_2&amount=25]

Here's the problem: Many people think that 2025 is an off-year and we can stop working for voting rights or thinking about our elections. But they're wrong. We still have elections across the country in 2025 to focus on, register voters for, and so much more.
Here's the other problem: We invested heavily in our work for 2024, so we need to rebuild our resources to give us the tools we need to increase participation in these elections, fight suppressive bills coming in state legislatures, register voters... the list goes on.
This is how we solve those problems: We set a massive end-of-year fundraising goal for December – $50,000. We're getting close, and if every voting rights supporter reading this chipped in $5, we'd cross the finish line in no time.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

clean_body: Your place in this fight | Peter— The fight for reproductive rights is deeply personal to me. An abortion saved my life—but not before Texas's cruel and extreme abortion ban pushed me to the brink of death. Just weeks after being discharged from the hospital, I met with the Center for Reproductive Rights. Within minutes, I knew they had my best interests at heart. They didn't just fight for me—they fought for everyone who has ever needed, or will ever need, reproductive health care. This fight isn't just about women or pregnant people—it affects all of us. That is why I hope you'll consider making a gift to the Center today. | "GIVE NOW: 10X MATCH" Starting now, every gift to the Center will be matched 10X thanks to generous donors. body:
Happy New Year! 2024 is now in the rearview mirror, and we have a big new year to look forward to. What can we expect in '25? | |
---
| | |
---

| Hello, I hope your holidays are going well. I wrote an [op-ed](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=0913c292a6&e=0f227c2ae3) in Newsweek to ring in the new year, with some bold predictions for 2025. I hope you enjoy it!

_**Expect More Lawmakers to Go 'Independent' in the Coming Year**_

Happy New Year! 2024 is now in the rearview mirror, and we have a big new year to look forward to. What can we expect in '25? Here are my top predictions for what we're likely to see:

For starters, the Republicans will struggle to pass legislation due to their historically narrow margin in the House. We saw this in December, as Elon Musk went against the budget plan that Speaker of the House Mike Johnson had painstakingly hammered out before Trump even took office. Extending Trump's tax cuts will become a major intra-party food fight with a few deficit hawks balking at anything that raises the deficit, which will be just about everything. Pity Mike Johnson; unifying the different factions of the GOP will be next to impossible given his lack of leverage. He might not last the year as Speaker, even as the Republicans have no one better situated to lead the caucus.

You can also expect at least one member of Congress or the Senate to declare him or herself an Independent, mirroring a trend. In this last Congress, two Senators—Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema—left the Democratic Party and became Independents. Expect the same to happen on the Republican side this time. It's not just a trend among lawmakers: 50 percent of voters now identify as Independents, according to Gallup, and Jim Duggan, the mayor of Detroit, has already declared that he's going to run for governor of Michigan as an Independent. Being an Independent will become more of a common attribute in 2025, as officials look to brand themselves as not beholden to one party or another.

Expect at least one Democrat to declare their presidential candidacy for 2028 in 2025, three years before the primary. Nature abhors a vacuum, and the Democratic Party is in the wilderness looking for an identity, and electing a DNC Chair that most Americans have never heard of isn't going to change that. Multiple heavyweights are going to declare in Fall of 2026, so why not get a jump on them and have the Left-leaning media all to yourself? They'll have you on cable news shows, as they don't have much else to talk about for the next two years. I declared early in the 2020 cycle because I knew I would need time to build up recognition. It had its plusses and minuses, but this cycle, the plusses outweigh the downsides for multiple candidates. Expect someone to take the plunge early, and for election season to be every season.

Next, I expect there will tragically be more assassination attempts on both CEOs and political figures. Luigi Mangione's murder of Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealth, unfortunately drew sympathetic reactions in many quarters. Trump of course survived one assassination attempt, perhaps two. In disintegrating and polarized societies, targeted violence becomes normalized. Unfortunately, the United States fits that description. One common pattern in decaying democracies are attacks on judicial figures. 2025 is likely to represent a high-water mark in political violence committed by the misguided, deranged and criminal.

I expect there to be multiple major strikes, including by teachers, airline workers, healthcare workers, and postal workers. 2024 had notable labor stoppages, including dockworkers and a recently resolved Actors and Writers Guild strike in Hollywood. A number of major contracts are up in 2025, and the pressure being brought to bear by automation is increasing. The Republican administration will be unlikely to intervene. At least one of these strikes will drag on for weeks, causing meaningful disruption.

Also, expect inflation to stay alive and well. The Fed signaled in December that it would not be cutting rates as much as many hoped to guard against inflation. Trump himself recently admitted "it's hard to make prices go down after they go up," and many companies have realized that they can pass costs along to consumers. Tariffs are inflationary, and so are deportations. Prices for many consumer goods will go up if tariffs are established on imports from certain countries. Housing prices will stay high too, as mortgage rates stay elevated compared to 2021 levels.

Finally, expect the movement to reduce smartphone use among teens to grow and spread to numerous states that implement phone-free schools. Jonathan Haidt's book The Anxious Generation has dominated the bestseller list for months, and parents have figured out that smartphones are not their kids' friends. Young people also are realizing that clicking on other people's exaggerated lifestyles doesn't lead to a positive frame of mind. There will be an impulse for many Americans to live simpler lives, and more people both old and young will opt out of social media networks.

Of course, the most important thing for each of us in the New Year will be how we approach opportunities and setbacks in our own lives. Try to look out for yourself and those around you. The institutional challenges are going to keep on picking up steam. If you want something to happen, you might have to do it yourself.

Here's to thriving in '25!

I wrote an in Newsweek to ring in the new year, with some bold predictions for 2025. I hope you enjoy it! Expect More Lawmakers to Go 'Independent' in the Coming Year Happy New Year! 2024 is now in the rearview mirror, and we have a big new year to look forward to. What can we expect in '25? Here are my top predictions for what we're likely to see: For starters, the Republicans will struggle to pass legislation due to their historically narrow margin in the House. We saw this in December, as Elon Musk went against the budget plan that Speaker of the House Mike Johnson had painstakingly hammered out before Trump even took office. Extending Trump's tax cuts will become a major intra-party food fight with a few deficit hawks balking at anything that raises the deficit, which will be just about everything. Pity Mike Johnson; unifying the different factions of the GOP will be next to impossible given his lack of leverage. He might not last the year as Speaker, even as the Republicans have no one better situated to lead the caucus. It's not just a trend among lawmakers: 50 percent of voters now identify as Independents, according to Gallup, and Jim Duggan, the mayor of Detroit, has already declared that he's going to run for governor of Michigan as an Independent. Being an Independent will become more of a common attribute in 2025, as officials look to brand themselves as not beholden to one party or another. name: OKGOP
subject: You won’t believe what happened over Christmas at the headquarters.
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_you_won_t_believe_what_happe&n=1)
---
Peter -- We hope everyone has had a very Merry Christmas and looking forward to a Happy New Year with President Donald Trump’s Inauguration coming up on January 20th. Unfortunately we experienced a major issue and we need your help. On Christmas Day an electric line to the OKGOP headquarters collapsed. It was discovered the next day by our team & we immediately contacted the electric company. After having them come out and evaluate the situation we were informed we would have to not just repair the exterior cable, but also bring things up to code in the building in order to get things fully restored. That means the electric meters that are currently INSIDE the building must be moved to the OUTSIDE. We received a bid for the work and in order for us to get things back up and going we need to immediately raise $13,000. We have a busy year coming up and in order to stop the leftist plan to allow Democrats to vote in Republican Primaries we must be firing on all cylinders, obviously getting this electric issue repaired is a first priority. ---
Dear Friend,
---
I didn’t want to bother you over the Christmas holiday, but I now have something very important to share with you.
---
Reports indicate that my trial is set to begin on January 16 – just days before President Trump’s inauguration.
---
**_This trial will determine whether the Left can seize my home in Florida and truly leave me with NOTHING. This is my _final_ chance to save my home._**
---
Since there’s no way I can pay the outrageous $148 MILLION judgment against me, they want to rob me of everything I own.
---
They want irreplaceable mementos I gave to my only son. They want personal gifts that I was given by allies abroad to show solidarity with America after the tragedy of September 11th.
---
During these difficult times, Christmas reminded me of what’s _truly_ important in life. Earthly possessions come and go – homes, cars, money all come to an end. But the Bible reminds us that _eternal_ “heavenly treasures” await us.
---
The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to my possessions.**
---
_"_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_

name: Rudy Giuliani
subject: I’m going to trial
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust
body:
My final chance to save my home...

They want “SEVERE” sanctions against me.
| [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zln1bf546nifc4ff788aj40qqphuas6ihepo4ll0_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdgm4o75c5h2bs)
---
Dear Friend,
---
I didn’t want to bother you over the Christmas holiday, but I now have something very important to share with you.
---
Reports indicate that my trial is set to begin on January 16 – just days before President Trump’s inauguration.
---
**_This trial will determine whether the Left can seize my home in Florida and truly leave me with NOTHING. This is my _final_ chance to save my home._**
---
Since there’s no way I can pay the outrageous $148 MILLION judgment against me, they want to rob me of everything I own.
---
They want irreplaceable mementos I gave to my only son. They want personal gifts that I was given by allies abroad to show solidarity with America after the tragedy of September 11th.
---
During these difficult times, Christmas reminded me of what’s _truly_ important in life. Earthly possessions come and go – homes, cars, money all come to an end. But the Bible reminds us that _eternal_ “heavenly treasures” await us.
---
The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to my possessions.**
---
_"_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---
**As I prepare for my January trial, I’m asking patriots like you to make a contribution to my Legal Defense Trust so that I can keep fighting for my freedom and justice against a rigged and weaponized legal system.**

body:
It’s New Year’s Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zomgulkttgp08cfkukvcp9nk8enijj49pvj9g03o_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdgm4o71cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

It's New Year's Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

Since you're a generous person, I'm sure you've received a LOT of requests for donations from many worthy causes.

But I just had to send you this request to support our 2024 year-end campaign before the clock runs out. I wouldn't write you if the cause weren't so urgent and important.

Your giving is important to starting 2025 ready for our new **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** right out of the gate.

[Will you give to restore liberty by **reaching** and **teaching** millions in 2025?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztpcpqubh3fkb0nvid6hnbldvkvmj2fga6jh2i98_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdgm4o71cjh2bs)

You and I both know that this is the surest way of protecting liberty in America--especially since you've seen how divided we are as a nation. And I'm sure you're as hopeful as I am about the prospects for liberty in 2025. That's one of the reasons for my urgency, in fact.

So, I'm counting on your help to implement our **Project to Revive and Restore Liberty Through Education** in 2025.

Your gift is especially needed because we refuse EVERY PENNY of taxpayer support--even indirect aid in the form of student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain independent and effective in the cause of liberty.

If you can help us then please **make your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $250 before midnight tonight using this secure link:**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf4ihatgv6gv7qdamucopa3qubh3a4tjn9606kv0_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdgm4o71cjh2bs)

I am deeply thankful for your interest in Hillsdale College. Please allow me to wish you and yours a blessed, healthy, and prosperous New Year!

Gratefully,

-bill

**P.S. Please take action before midnight tonight (and your gift will be tax-deductible in 2024). Thank you! Here 's a quick, secure link to our special giving page:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zafloorj95l9ii914vfgv8k06brqig4cplaji3co_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdgm4o71cjh2bs)

name: Jennifer Nassour (MassGOP)
subject: It's the final countdown
body:
2024 was a pivotal moment for the MassGOP
| | | | | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yRUQCYluQg7wlOrwtjg99_9yh5WioZ5Q0qm7kP8mso74BxMXJP32yWe8F6Slj5OLagO-fBuJAs8DgX7VgZL16UvTmcy-OjU5VVKn2kovzLjpVaQ6OY8UaxaSbBoYaXPO31r0-M1sctS9gRcwlS3jWQ==&c=wsvD3Wl-uRa3Dr9LkEENOabMT2nOxv1GNzVBmkv9Y9LaVNMrkojxCg==&ch=gH5gz8A20h8lSRYHbCk_mpDf_QovTUlMW78JRLka0bDGVGJnmgXtTw==)
---
| Friends,
It's the final countdown! Midnight will be here before we know it. Today is the last day of fundraising for 2024, and as our newly appointed Finance Chair, I'm coming to YOU for help.
After all, it's because of the generous support of members like YOU that the 2024 election cycle will be remembered as a pivotal moment in Massachusetts Republican Party history.
* Flipping multiple seats from blue to red;

* Successfully defending every seat held by our incumbents;

* Supporting President Donald Trump and increasing his Republican support in nearly every county.

For the first time since 1984, the Republican Party made history by defending all incumbents seeking re-election and winning new victories across the state during a Presidential election year.
It's clear that the citizens of our Commonwealth are embracing our commonsense Republican ideals, and a truly viable two-party system in Massachusetts is no longer a pipe dream.
Now, we begin to look forward to the next election when a critically important and undeniably winnable governor's race tops the ballot. We need your ongoing support to build on our momentum and lay the foundation for a Republican victory.
History has shown that our citizens want a check on the legislature - they like to have a Republican in the Governor's Office.
It's up to us to make it happen.
---

It's clear that the citizens of our Commonwealth are embracing our commonsense Republican ideals, and a truly viable two-party system in Massachusetts is no longer a pipe dream. Now, we begin to look forward to the next election when a critically important and undeniably winnable governor's race tops the ballot. We need your ongoing support to build on our momentum and lay the foundation for a Republican victory. History has shown that our citizens want a check on the legislature - they like to have a Republican in the Governor's Office. ---
| Virginia soared in 2024 -- reaching new heights, leading the way on the issues that matter most, receiving well-deserved recognitions and building for an even better future.

In a new video, Governor Youngkin celebrates 2024 as the Year of the Commonwealth and pledges to continue working together to further this great momentum into 2025.

"2024 was the year of the Commonwealth and I couldn't be more honored to serve as your Governor," Youngkin says in the video. "Thank you to all Virginians for working so hard to make our Commonwealth the best place to live, work, and raise a family. As we look ahead, Virginia will keep leading and Virginia will keep winning."
---

---
| **The Top 10 wins for Virginia in 2024 include:** 1. [Virginia named Top State for Business by CNBC](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f17665a04d33c081cb2a66fb00256a8a42dc5d49331af1711bcad0187995d9047ac3829c6dc0564442850958cee408e6263e900d49ef4a6fd523e "Virginia named Top State for Business by CNBC ")

2. Virginia celebrates [two-year anniversary of the Right Help, Right Now plan](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766a8882b8e7724d3c967d31b6bd2b6a0bfd0d0b53662877e23df469e33821afcb8f880991801a013341199840fc10627ff9455e61cd74aa809 "two-year anniversary of the Right Help, Right Now plan") that is transforming behavioral health services across the Commonwealth

3\. Virginia generates [surplus of over $1 billion](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f176658e6d4d502709ecb17edf67acce43a80e93f72702900acb7b01b5cb54f4cd25305401c15afcda532d6b0f0025246a313da6e12882175451b "surplus of over $1 billion") for third year in a row

4. Virginia Derby [becomes qualifying race for Kentucky Derby](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766543947bcd8a085525fcdaeb56397c9b634abd956aac12e2e3cc36885e0e581cef72bf1656abd990a268af7424f5b7125d875e05830788aab "becomes qualifying race for Kentucky Derby")

5. Virginia [reverses out-migration trend for the first time in a decade](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766d222ebdca8ba6fea18572fc4034016eff22a100fa2d4894cdc275ca4880b2197b855ff946bd409647a48a3d076d400566978677990d52a46 "reverses out-migration trend for the first time in a decade"), with more people moving into Virginia than moving away

6. Virginia [tourism industry generates a record-high $33.3 billion](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766f4b351af85d6f2fe042eb3347d7a378ccd352979ce7ec982904e7ae91e7633a0f20936271737d1065c925bcb3587206c215748d6394a7516 "tourism industry generates a record-high $33.3 billion") in visitor spending

7. Virginia [passes goal of creating 10,000 high wage, high growth business startups](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766976f9fc8dc37c8d2410f66cc93c1389f64fddfb2b7f05a78f699f8875e84bc235bd337b595711f4c4324646dc30b5f6ebfc052af2456bd9e "passes goal of creating 10,000 high wage, high growth business startups") two years earlier than expected

8. Virginia [leads the nation in cellphone-free education](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766972391fbd713ef3ac5605079d9e3e4854ed54e70b40b3817e0a7970cddd075b4cc42055359f1c5d073168bed4952179aef82899f0957769e "leads the nation in cellphone-free education") for K-12 schools

9\. Virginia [declares independence from California's electric vehicle mandate](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766d797fabc103aae8f5af7e60ec5c7cb6990fb785dc5a504f3104c49ab3eed422f6f28a10b8b34ba0919a65f4e7e1d5faa29ddba9b9030c20f "declares independence from California's electric vehicle mandate")

10\. Virginia has seen [nearly $90 billion in investment commitments from businesses](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e6baa575d96f1766196ea72dffec90710791a39903172ab7d60e962f49aa16504e90f55333b0b40107898627bd78283193f08d47990e2dcb6d69ff7f9fd0bb2a "nearly $90 billion in investment commitments from businesses") since 2022

## Texas Drone Company Cancels Shows
Sky Elements, a Fort Worth-based company that produces large-scale drone shows across the country, had its FAA waiver suspended after several drones collided during a Dec. 21 show in Lake Eola, Fla. This forced the [cancellation of planned New Year's Eve shows](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL0O3CAQhJ8Gd1iw4L-CIo27S5vSWsNyRsHmZLjj_PaRkzrtjPRp5vv1WB4YYjieP3EnU74-LSBAcwlcycVhiNeiG2dW4SbZkJGD6nqtRyWbzXT9hN6jBZK-B7uCA9AjgrBrJ_ykm2BumAQlpVQAurV9Jzq7OrXqdXR2YFqQCyWdbdmo0Bezj1f60NnatDfRbKW8MlM_GMwM5lprWz3iXTKY8SzBRmIwH1Qzgzkmi5HBfNL7COngJVU6ucMYMfPjIu7OdBDPW6o8_744RdrpKPlfnvn75bDcPBgHPmkv9ADAnaCe6072HBEHbr0AGtU6jEo0p3GvGmIMub-_PHcM8e_08l-XHwN_AgAA__8N2nW7) in Dallas and Manhattan. The ensuing crash [severely injured a 7-year-old boy](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OozAUxfGnMd1F_gRSuNiGLttuiS5cE1trcGR74vD2o0w_9ZGOfvr_uy93DDGcj794OFvfe1oklxqEBCUWwhCvRXdkV0430TkrRmUGrSclOm_JKc61oWHap20kQqOJbsJMwyhWVNgF-zkTUgkhlJS63wbDzbaSWvU60TYyzR2FmnJfvavujWWPV3q53G_p6KL1tT4LU3-YnJmcW2t9c8V_RiZnzDVs0TE5H-mA8nT4v0D6qoB7dRlKOqFhAR8qrBcgUE6nA6yQcsSTUgGfYiC8oPjUmJwHJc1kuOmypWcLMYYyfIiPA0P8EdVfE72s_A4AAP__NsRp8Q), who reportedly required heart surgery. The company stated that it is committed to safety and is working with the FAA and local officials to [determine the cause of the mishap](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAQhZ8Gd1hmwI5TUNzGXW67pTXAOGYXg2VISN5-5fRbjTTnR5_O122-oQ8-3v_jRrq8ljRDB4oL4FLMDn14z6px2nTuKhrS4iL7QalRimbVdL04NSCiEdiRlL0DA8aose9GHHFovD7LBEghhARQrR36rrfGSaPM6OyFqY6cL-loy0qFXpiX8E5POlqbtibotZQ9M_mPwcRgqrW21uRINZ86g-kTYTCdLwbTgsjzI-8UXeYxHWXlHwd3R4rEbdp2jO_Mg7cUM3FcCh3crj447uP346Dz8rymygPmwivRD4OpObTbqw_B5-Fkvm_owwex_LnZU8NvAAAA__9-O3JF). [Founded in 2020](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAUBb8Gd1hwAccpKF7jLq_d0sJwHZAIWMCG5O9XztZbj87RaL5u682EGNL9v3mgbq89r8BAUg5U8NWZEN-rHJzemLvyATW_CDVJOQs-eK2YsYD7PMEmYEJn8MoNc7NUiPvMzBD0ecZBcM4FgBztpJiymxOb3GZnL0QydKHlMjaPDV-m7vGdn1hGmx9D1L61oxLxj8BCYOm9j9aXnE5KYEnYK4HF5-_acqKfPYHFlBZsRAKLKzkhrT73X0htMdXTkGxwmBoFxphSTI6HP4ai3dFDjKFOp9f9YUL8aLQ_uzw1_AQAAP__6Z1mbw), Sky Elements has produced shows for several Major League Baseball teams and major corporations, including DirecTV, Paramount Pictures, and the Houston Livestock Show & Rodeo. Decades after being injured in Vietnam, Amarillo veteran Ron Mahan finally received his Purple Heart medal, and now he doesn't go anywhere without it. Check out below! ## China Hacks Treasury Department
Treasury Department officials confirmed that a state-sponsored [Chinese hacking group](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jmAQkeGLp4S9eOFoHnQItNBM-x_PdVunc-6XS6r9t8cymn7fHpVrS0lBkGUFwAl2IOLuVzVl2wCyKg7NCKq9QXpUalu2ilDMboK6AxixJjCDgMGAapYYHgjOqSfdsESCGE1Er2KJzUStyd0qOQGpgaMCQqtf8uaaOISz7LC2vvy9plG4mejckPBhOD6TiOfrv7DY_25gwmQh8ZTA39XhOdDKa9caro2l5P3tzZuC_rcyesjUfnfzBwH9OGDTnFio6481Qqr35zwmgzjF214XmknFO7XJkaHqtL-S-H_tvzsvAbAAD__66LaHY) exploited third-party software to gain access to department computers, describing this as a "major incident." Officials were notified of the breach on Dec. 8. During the breach, the group [remotely infiltrated](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOqzAQheGnMZ0jPDZwKVzchi7bbokGMw6TGDuynUS8_Yrttz7Sp6P_-zpfkQPH2xfuZKtPM7RgpAKp1bwih2M2zWo9EZBuyKpBd70xo-mazfZ68C3oEQfXDkiLGb1fez-OKyla_lHD9tQUaKWU7oy-kELdGbWg6UalOxCmpZVrypd74lg38uFIb8oXl_Ym2K3WZxH6v4BJwBSPZyr1nARMJyxgUiBg0q2A6VVkpE8RMLmNIxWSG7oH5SI5eg41YyX5KrJmwvLKh-Qod7ynLN2xUMZa0T1k8p4dYyiyUgjSpXjLVE61yXZ9fjgELv0gTHvbkcPvz_pXt7eFnwAAAP__A1VwsQ) the Treasury’s cloud service and workstations to acquire unclassified documents. The Treasury has [collaborated with the FBI, CISA](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00M1qxCAUxfGnMTtDrh8JLlwUSnZTuusyGL1ObjExqJ0hb1-m-64P_Dj8v27LzVGi4_7hdrQt5kUMQnEQXMISHKVrUV2wEVGg7NDCJPWolFG626yJIGNcxxjDoCCYIL0GNHpVwzQpOXZkXxoICQBSK9kjOKkVrE5pA1ILpgYM1HLpvzMdbcOYrvzA0vu8d8lurZ2VyTcmZiZmt_oDn7W_59fMxPyZEzXylYm5FXT1p1w84OlK2_FofKPG_bViWQs6v3G_0eF4PfNRc8HAnW-58BwjeXLppdSWy8XkTIHJd4BJDGY0qis2nE9Kieo4MTXcd0fp72H7r9jDit8AAAD___e8bnk), and the intelligence community to investigate the breach and assess its impact, according to officials. One security expert described the [technique of exploiting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO5CAQBb8GZ7boBg_jgOASsr30QgubnnXvYbCAHct_f_Llm1Xw9FSqPx_zh-fI6fO338m2V55Rou4BewVz8ByvWXfBvoiQVEcWjBofWk967DYLi4cJaNHLoh9mImng-XyqKcA6kpSmY3u_ASoAUKNWA4FXo4bF63ECNaLQkgK3XIavzKlt9IpXflMZ1rx30W6tHVWoXwKdQHee5_BdfcvBX_dAoKstl0ugS3RWge7IkRuvN1KktXFON98SAh2gQKekQLdunKhSv_n1L5Xat0K-fperD3T40nZKrd_9Vy49p5UDpSbQGaNwUpOR0gh0XbHhODlGrg8jtPzcPcf_2u2njG-L_wIAAP__hqRybQ) third-party services as a prominent method used by China-linked groups.

The U.S. announced on Monday nearly [$6 billion in aid to Ukraine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFyszAQhJ8GOjHcScJ2oeJv6Py3KZmTdZhLhOQRshm_fYYU6dLuzu7sfh_X6UoSJd3_08quznnCHo0CVBqmQBLfk2mDm5mRdcsOTtoOxlyMbRdnZjA9AfXekvfsL34IIcznAc-aNehW3NEGqAFAW6M7BtLWgCdjL6AtNqbnIDWX7jNLqgvP8Z1fXLpbXtvollofW6P_NTg2OO773hV-Vi7b4R9KLjE0OHoJnBSllJ_pxptCq7zEKDmpufC2qFWiVCpvRRLU86uQJFa_T_sGx7a48NiP0DacGtPfV5L4M6P-heXl8DsAAP__bShkGQ), including $2.5 billion in military assistance and $3.4 billion in budget support, as President Joe Biden aims to bolster Ukraine before leaving office on Jan. 20. Dear Friend,

It's New Year's Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

Since you're a generous person, I'm sure you've received a LOT of requests for donations from many worthy causes.

But I just had to send you this request to support our 2024 year-end campaign before the clock runs out. I wouldn't write you if the cause weren't so urgent and important.

Your giving is important to starting 2025 ready for our new **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** right out of the gate.

[Will you give to restore liberty by **reaching** and **teaching** millions in 2025?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3adf40a7991c456eb2d2e4a4826da43d&_e=N960MJaYWIFqPn-Gyz0nI5sSCNeWVhitmVYnK3kXkzwaroyfwswfIvjvB3v0J742998NvO2l9oQB5C6QO48ty-5AgwOsRuwQeBsKmiZxxgdo9kpbQwqeEDA6af4RdKNIsNtMgpd4aIHapV1xz19oqTLFGqC-Jtd5Iv6ZhomPZPF-okPIpBKii_MEA_k2iKpUfGILzm1I4S-k11QZNKY2Mrv5MxOVr4ZycfKVxZeMEuvi8rmkAI0QyLk32vfhX1s-4JXWRvVh76IWlBwAcFUUrEXCWbgwiYVSfxakQYDX9ZnvJNdEacDeGTpYyubYg53txMHcURd4OWLJqJdNxilvQh4_m4vwPRFEiKr-qWDEO4kP4ybHXMD6RDExfPo4dTx8)

You and I both know that this is the surest way of protecting liberty in America--especially since you've seen how divided we are as a nation. And I'm sure you're as hopeful as I am about the prospects for liberty in 2025. That's one of the reasons for my urgency, in fact.

So, I'm counting on your help to implement our **Project to Revive and Restore Liberty Through Education** in 2025.

Your gift is especially needed because we refuse EVERY PENNY of taxpayer support--even indirect aid in the form of student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain independent and effective in the cause of liberty.

If you can help us then please **make your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $250 before midnight tonight using this secure link:**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3adf40a7991c456eb2d2e4a4826da43d&_e=N960MJaYWIFqPn-Gyz0nI5sSCNeWVhitmVYnK3kXkzwaroyfwswfIvjvB3v0J742998NvO2l9oQB5C6QO48ty-5AgwOsRuwQeBsKmiZxxgdo9kpbQwqeEDA6af4RdKNIsNtMgpd4aIHapV1xz19oqTLFGqC-Jtd5Iv6ZhomPZPF-okPIpBKii_MEA_k2iKpUfGILzm1I4S-k11QZNKY2Mrv5MxOVr4ZycfKVxZeMEuskGktr93sKBXIJ0V8FfOb7jqm5XMsLxPYalpzd9fTuZPZWeqHHn7w5qykUsXJaCN_ZK63XP7hYJ5vjPfqdivNfyc9aJ-F9bIYdvTSmVutZquawRKSsnotnbgi6ecslxNqpMtP7b06hu0IeMClan6rP)

I am deeply thankful for your interest in Hillsdale College. Please allow me to wish you and yours a blessed, healthy, and prosperous New Year!

Gratefully,

-bill

This sponsored message from First Look News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| |
Dear Friend,

Today is the last day of 2024. But our work is far from over. And we need your help.

You can be sure that in the critical year ahead, the far-Left will be working harder than ever to undermine the informed patriotism of young Americans.

This is why we at Hillsdale College plan to redouble our efforts in 2025 to reach and teach additional millions of citizens--especially younger Americans--about our nation's great heritage of liberty.

**Midnight tonight is the deadline to give your most generous year-end gift to support Hillsdale 's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

We still have not reached our **$6,000,000** year-end online fundraising goal.

**Please make a special tax-deductible gift _before midnight tonight_ to help us expand our educational outreach efforts in 2025 through our Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education. **

By helping us reach our goal...

...you will help increase the reach and influence of _Imprimis_ , our free digest of liberty;

...you will support the production and promotion of free online courses on the Constitution, American history, Christianity, and many other topics;

...and you will help launch and support Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 schools nationwide.

**Time is running out.** Please use the secure link below to make your best tax-deductible gift **before midnight tonight.**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z9t2tsd48n68aupbdqglu2tiht5p5315qe8nbkkg_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdhm2ob4cjh2bs)

Because Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny from the government--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans--the College can remain genuinely **independent** and stay true to its 180-year-old mission.

But this means the College's work is entirely dependent on the generosity of citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Thank you again for your support in 2024. On behalf of all of us at Hillsdale College, I wish you and yours a healthy and prosperous new year.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: History Facts
subject: Here's what happened when pirates kidnapped Julius Caesar
body:
Before he emerged as a military hero and the envy of Roman senators who feared his popular reach, Julius Caesar demonstrated his ability to manipulate minds during a reported encounter with pirates around 75 BCE. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68cbiq4tcrfquchzdtlaj5zhh6ashrfhcn0wmy795jzxdszmwrb0s3bl2xgcevct0h91di6xu4unsiw1xzufuc1vx2db3ecxcl2bqs88awjw444gocqfwzrrw4it905n171p7rrje1sqid596&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
---
---
# [Julius Caesar was once kidnapped by pirates.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| B efore he emerged as a military hero and the envy of Roman senators who feared his popular reach, Julius Caesar demonstrated his ability to manipulate minds during a reported encounter with pirates around 75 BCE.
---
Although the tale varies based on the historian who relayed it, the general outline holds that Caesar was captured off the coast of modern-day Turkey. According to Plutarch’s _Life of Caesar_ , the young nobleman laughed when he heard that his ransom was set at a mere 20 talents of silver (a huge sum of money, possibly worth millions today) and suggested it be raised to the more appropriate sum of 50 talents. After sending his men to fetch the money, Caesar proceeded to boss around his captors: He forced them to listen to his poems and speeches, calling them illiterate savages when they didn't approve; ordered them to keep quiet when he tried to sleep; and brazenly announced that they would all be executed once he was free.
Released when the ransom arrived after 38 days, Caesar proceeded to the nearby port of Miletus (an ancient Greek city in modern Turkey), raised a fleet, and hunted down the pirates. When the governor of Asia wavered over the fate of the imprisoned men, Caesar took charge of the situation and had them all crucified.
Given that the story may well have [originated](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) with Caesar himself, one could be forgiven for finding the details of this seafaring adventure a little fishy. Nevertheless, it fits in well within the biographical narrative of a powerful man who wrested control of a war-torn republic and helped usher its transition to the Roman Empire.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Caesar was allegedly not a talented poet.
Those “illiterate” pirates may have been on to something when they rejected Caesar's poetic efforts. Although the Roman dictator is credited with composing several verses during his life, including a poem dedicated to Hercules and another describing a journey to Spain, only a few lines from his oeuvre survive today. This is partly due to the failure of medieval monks to copy what they considered to be minor documents, but also due to deliberate censorship by Caesar's esteemed successor. As explained by the historian Suetonius, some of Caesar's early works were set for posthumous publication, until Emperor Augustus abruptly squashed the idea. That was just as well, according to the historian Tacitus, who [asserted](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spcxjc&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that Caesar's overall reputation benefited from the lack of access to his poetry.

clean_body: Before he emerged as a military hero and the envy of Roman senators who feared his popular reach, Julius Caesar demonstrated his ability to manipulate minds during a reported encounter with pirates around 75 BCE. | B efore he emerged as a military hero and the envy of Roman senators who feared his popular reach, Julius Caesar demonstrated his ability to manipulate minds during a reported encounter with pirates around 75 BCE. Although the tale varies based on the historian who relayed it, the general outline holds that Caesar was captured off the coast of modern-day Turkey. According to Plutarch’s Life of Caesar , the young nobleman laughed when he heard that his ransom was set at a mere 20 talents of silver (a huge sum of money, possibly worth millions today) and suggested it be raised to the more appropriate sum of 50 talents. After sending his men to fetch the money, Caesar proceeded to boss around his captors: He forced them to listen to his poems and speeches, calling them illiterate savages when they didn't approve; ordered them to keep quiet when he tried to sleep; and brazenly announced that they would all be executed once he was free. Released when the ransom arrived after 38 days, Caesar proceeded to the nearby port of Miletus (an ancient Greek city in modern Turkey), raised a fleet, and hunted down the pirates. When the governor of Asia wavered over the fate of the imprisoned men, Caesar took charge of the situation and had them all crucified. Given that the story may well have with Caesar himself, one could be forgiven for finding the details of this seafaring adventure a little fishy. Nevertheless, it fits in well within the biographical narrative of a powerful man who wrested control of a war-torn republic and helped usher its transition to the Roman Empire. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Year Julius Caesar was born 100 BCE | | Surviving biographies in Plutarch's “Parallel Lives” series 48 | Surviving biographies in Plutarch's “Parallel Lives” series 48 | | Words in William Shakespeare's play The Tragedy of Julius Caesar 19,703 | | Calories in a traditional Caesar salad 470 | Calories in a traditional Caesar salad 470 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Caesar was allegedly not a talented poet. Those “illiterate” pirates may have been on to something when they rejected Caesar's poetic efforts. Although the Roman dictator is credited with composing several verses during his life, including a poem dedicated to Hercules and another describing a journey to Spain, only a few lines from his oeuvre survive today. This is partly due to the failure of medieval monks to copy what they considered to be minor documents, but also due to deliberate censorship by Caesar's esteemed successor. As explained by the historian Suetonius, some of Caesar's early works were set for posthumous publication, until Emperor Augustus abruptly squashed the idea. That was just as well, according to the historian Tacitus, who that Caesar's overall reputation benefited from the lack of access to his poetry. name: Hillsdale College via Updates For Great Americans
subject: We need to hear from you…
body:
Today is the last day of 2024. But our work is far from over. And we need your help.

This sponsored message from Great American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ztn271qpsk0k7d1n4bvo3v6i96al3qsvm34r1nv0_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdhmapj4cth2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

Today is the last day of 2024. But our work is far from over. And we need your help.

You can be sure that in the critical year ahead, the far-Left will be working harder than ever to undermine the informed patriotism of young Americans.

This is why we at Hillsdale College plan to redouble our efforts in 2025 to reach and teach additional millions of citizens--especially younger Americans--about our nation's great heritage of liberty.

**Midnight tonight is the deadline to give your most generous year-end gift to support Hillsdale 's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

We still have not reached our **$6,000,000** year-end online fundraising goal.

**Please make a special tax-deductible gift _before midnight tonight_ to help us expand our educational outreach efforts in 2025 through our Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education. **

By helping us reach our goal...

...you will help increase the reach and influence of _Imprimis_ , our free digest of liberty;

...you will support the production and promotion of free online courses on the Constitution, American history, Christianity, and many other topics;

...and you will help launch and support Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 schools nationwide.

**Time is running out.** Please use the secure link below to make your best tax-deductible gift **before midnight tonight.**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zfsnmpjaat2cnjf7hc37nqur4kmg2v2o4rdrrn20_rp22sh2s8i6epj5cdhmapj4cth2bs)

Because Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny from the government--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans--the College can remain genuinely **independent** and stay true to its 180-year-old mission.

But this means the College's work is entirely dependent on the generosity of citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Thank you again for your support in 2024. On behalf of all of us at Hillsdale College, I wish you and yours a healthy and prosperous new year.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| |
Dear Friend,

It's New Year's Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

Since you're a generous person, I'm sure you've received a LOT of requests for donations from many worthy causes.

This is it . With just hours left in the year to raise $500,000, I need your help now to ensure we can be there for our service members in 2025 and beyond.
And to help make sure we reach this critical goal, **a generous group of donors is matching your gift four times, up to a total of $150,000, until midnight tonight!**
**[This is the best match opportunity the USO has offered, and we can't afford to waste it. There are so many service members who are depending on the USO, and we are depending on you. ](https://links.e.uso.)**
[4X THE VALUE OF YOUR
TAX-DEDUCTIBLE DONATION NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
**[So please, will you make a tax-deductible gift of $29 or more to QUADRUPLE the value of your gift for our service members?](https://links.e.uso.)**
My brother served in the U.S. Navy, so I've seen firsthand the sacrifices service members make, from spending long months isolated at sea to missing precious holidays moments with loved ones. That's why I'm proud the USO can bring a small piece of home to our heroes through care packages, warm holiday meals and Wi-Fi connections to video call their families.
And why I'm personally asking in these final hours of this year: **[Will you make a 4X-matched, tax-deductible gift of 29 (becomes $116) or more to help the USO support our service members throughout 2025?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/mWbZT-)**
As we close out 2024, we reflect on the extraordinary challenges our military faced this year. These heroes ...
* Provided emergency response relief during the devastating hurricanes -- Helene and Milton -- that destroyed so much of the Southeast
* Supported our allies during increased conflict in the Middle East
* Spent long months deployed overseas, with limited contact with family
* Missed spending the holiday season with their loved ones

Our service members showed resilience and bravery this year in the face of unpredictable adversity and continue to sacrifice so much for our country. Now it's our turn to stand with them as they prepare for whatever 2025 may bring.
[4X THE VALUE OF YOUR
TAX-DEDUCTIBLE DONATION NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
**But we can 't do it without you . As a nonprofit, we rely on the generosity of supporters like you to carry out our mission.**
**[Will you please make your tax-deductible gift of $29 (becomes $116) or more by midnight tonight so your contribution will go four times as far in supporting our heroes in uniform in the year ahead?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[4X THE VALUE OF YOUR
TAX-DEDUCTIBLE DONATION NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Thank you for standing with us and with our heroes. Together, we can show our service members they're never far from our hearts, no matter where they are in the world.
On behalf of all of us here at the USO, and the millions of service members and families we support, I want to wish you a very happy and blessed New Year!
Tabitha Glenn, VP, USO

We’re at the Precipice of Real Change
[LET’S FINISH WHAT WE STARTED](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em1?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_ask_12_31_24_1&n=5)
Dear Peter,
This journey has been nothing short of extraordinary.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has dedicated his life to fighting for our children's health and our nation's future.
Along the way, countless supporters like you have sacrificed your time, your resources, and your belief in this mission, which has brought us to this pivotal moment.
We’ve faced relentless challenges, and yet we’ve stood firm. Together, we have built a movement rooted in courage, truth, and an unshakable commitment to Make America Healthy Again.
**On the last day of this historic year, we stand at the precipice of real change.**
[My Best Year-End Gift](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em1?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_ask_12_31_24_1&n=6)
As President Trump prepares to take office, Kennedy is ready to step into his role as Secretary of Health and Human Services.
This is an unprecedented opportunity to transform our health agencies and _bring hope to millions of families across the nation_.
But before we can begin this critical work, we need your help. Throughout this campaign, the denial of Secret Service protection left us no choice but to _incur millions of dollars in private security costs_.
Federal law prohibits large donors from covering this expense—it’s up to supporters like you. Every dollar counts.

| | | **December 31st, 2024** |
---|---|---|---
| | |
### Senate Update: Goodbye 2024, Hello 2025
As 2024 comes to an end, I wanted to give you one last update on the 118th Congress. After many difficult months, we passed a bipartisan compromise to keep the federal government open, help disaster victims, and fully fund the replacement of the Key Bridge. If this month was any preview, we're in for a chaotic four years. But we still delivered key wins for the people of Maryland - from providing federal funding for the Key Bridge project to finally passing the Social Security Fairness Act. Here are some highlights:
### Keeping the Government Open to Serve Americans
One of Congress's central responsibilities is to fund the federal government. And while we had a bipartisan compromise deal to do so, we hit a sudden snag with days to go. Elon Musk and Donald Trump sent House Republicans into a delay spiral - bringing us back to governing by tweet. Despite the Republican chaos that brought us dangerously close to a government shutdown just before the holidays, I'm glad we were able to reach an [11th-hour bipartisan agreement](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-vote-to-ensure-full-federal-funding-for-key-bridge-replacement-avert-government-shutdown&redir_log=130027032081167). This legislation will move the Key Bridge replacement forward while providing relief to other communities across the country hit by disasters. It also prevents a government shutdown, ensuring that federal employees can continue to provide the country with vital services and receive paychecks for the work they do on behalf of the American people. That being said, I was disappointed that once again our Republican colleagues chose a short-term patch, instead of passing a year-long funding bill that would truly meet the shifting priorities of our nation and our state. This means that come March, we'll once again need to work towards a long-term spending bill, where I'll continue fighting to deliver for Maryland. We also achieved other bipartisan priorities in the final weeks. That included passing the annual National Defense Authorization Act, legislation that invests in our military installations and the men and women of our armed forces and is important to maintaining our national security. While there were many things within this legislation I did not support, [I voted in favor of the bill](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2f12%2f18%2f2024%2fvan-hollen-secures-key-provisions-in-annual-defense-bill-passed-by-senate&redir_log=001849892409946) as it will support our servicemembers - including a significant pay raise for junior enlisted members - as well as our local Maryland installations. We also passed the Social Security Fairness Act, bipartisan legislation I cosponsored, to ensure public sector workers and their families can receive full Social Security benefits. For over forty years, a pair of laws from the 70s and 80s have reduced Social Security benefits for public workers, from first responders to teachers to food safety inspectors. These workers paid into Social Security for their entire lives; it's just plain wrong for them to receive anything less than full benefits. For years, we're been trying to fix this issue. This bill will secure full Social Security benefits for 3 million Americans, including over 54,000 Marylanders. They served our country. They deserve to retire with dignity. I'm also proud to report that the Senate unanimously passed our Chesapeake National Recreation Act. This legislation, which Congressman Sarbanes and I introduced after a months-long public feedback process, would unite voluntarily contributed park areas and Bay properties as a national recreation area under the National Park Service. This will help the Bay get more federal resources to conserve our environment, celebrate our Bay history and culture, and support sustainable economic opportunity. The Chesapeake Bay is both a Maryland and a national treasure, and it deserves to be recognized as such. While there was not enough time to get a vote on the bill in the House before adjournment, we have built tremendous momentum - which should help us get it adopted in the next Congress.
### **Rebuilding the Key Bridge**
For 47 years, the Key Bridge has been a vital thoroughfare for the Baltimore region and national commerce. It carried over 34,000 travelers a day, and stood as the gateway to the Port of Baltimore, which each year welcomes 1,800 ships, supports over 27,000 local jobs, and generates $70 billion in revenue. When the bridge collapsed, it was not only a local tragedy, but a national one. We lost six Baltimore construction workers who were working the overnight shift. Thousands of longshoremen were temporarily put out of work or faced greatly diminished hours. Every small business and industry that depended on the Port of Baltimore faced disruptions. And today, many communities and Marylanders are impacted by the burden of taking longer, more congested routes without the Key Bridge. But as the bridge came apart, we came together. A heroic officer of the Maryland Transportation Authority stopped traffic from crossing the bridge moments before it collapsed, saving lives, and other first responders saved two workers who survived the collapse. President Biden directed the Coast Guard to lead a Unified Command of local, state, and federal agencies. It was a whole-of-government effort: I'm grateful to Governor Moore, Mayor Scott, County Executive Olszewski, and every other leader who stepped up. Senator Cardin, Congressman Mfume and I worked with Team Maryland to continue the federal response - we quickly secured emergency highway funding to aid in the recovery effort. Members of the Unified Command recovered the bodies of six fallen construction workers, then worked rapidly to clear the debris from the shipping channel and re-open the Port of Baltimore in just 11 weeks. While work on the ground was underway, we were also busy in Congress fighting to shore up the support Maryland needed to secure full federal funding to rebuild the bridge. In April, Senator Cardin, Congressman Mfume, and I, joined by the full Team Maryland, introduced bipartisan, bicameral legislation to secure 100% federal funding for the replacement. Our bill also ensured that any proceeds from insurance claims or litigation would go back to the federal taxpayers. Time and again, we have supported other states in their times of great need, so we argued, now it was time for these states to have our back as well. After much drama, they came through and embraced the time-honored American spirit of helping neighbors in their hour of need.
### **PSA: Protect Your Family from Online Scams**
One danger we all face is online scams - right now, my team is hearing from more and more Marylanders ensnared by fraud. There are tech support scams, in which criminals pose as tech support representatives to gain access to victims' computers, and investment fraud, in which fraudsters lure their victims with a seemingly lucrative investment plan.

The scammers are growing more sophisticated every day, many using cryptocurrency to funnel your money overseas and make it almost impossible to get it back. In some cases, they slowly build trust with their intended targets online, posing as a new friend or even a romantic interest. To stay safe, don't share sensitive personal or financial information online, especially with someone you've never met in real life. Maryland saw almost 2,000 reported victims in 2023, losing around $72.4 million. Many more have not come forward. To protect yourself from scams, the FBI says that your best defense is "healthy skepticism." Scammers want you to react quickly; always remember to slow down. If you get a suspicious message, don't respond immediately - take a beat. To learn more about staying safe, [click here to visit the FBI's webpage](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.fbi.gov%2fhow-we-can-help-you%2fscams-and-safety%2fcommon-frauds-and-scams&redir_log=126777712375558). If you believe you may be the target of a scam, you can file a complaint by [clicking here and visiting the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.ic3.gov%2f&redir_log=407961048134). I'm also working to take action in Congress to help tackle this issue. To protect Americans from fraud, I've authored bipartisan legislation that would help crack down on scams. Our bill, the [Empowering States to Protect Seniors from Bad Actors Act](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fan-hollen-warnock-introduce-bipartisan-bill-to-crack-down-on-scams-targeting-seniors&redir_log=538968659404965), would give states more resources to investigate scammers, upgrade technology, enhance training, and raise public awareness of the latest threats. Whether it's on one of these issues - or dozens of others - my office is always ready to serve Marylanders and provide assistance. [Click here to learn what our office can do for you](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fconstituent-services&redir_log=427117238233382). Don't hesitate to reach out if we can ever be of service.
### **Our Thanks to Senator Cardin**
Senator Cardin has been a great friend and wonderful partner in the U.S. Senate. [Here is a testimonial video](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15610.42166783.6851569.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2fwatch%3fv%3dYmW8vC2H5Ac&redir_log=908839736629287) we prepared in his honor. **And Thank You!** It's clear that the year ahead will present new challenges. In all the battles to come, I'll be glad to have Team Maryland - especially my new partner, Senator-elect Angela Alsobrooks - working with me on behalf of all Marylanders and our fellow Americans. And thank you for being fully engaged in advancing our great American experiment in democracy. Together, we will work to ensure that our brightest days are still ahead. Happy New Year! clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | | December 31st, 2024 | ---|---|---|--- | | | Senate Update: Goodbye 2024, Hello 2025 As 2024 comes to an end, I wanted to give you one last update on the 118th Congress. After many difficult months, we passed a bipartisan compromise to keep the federal government open, help disaster victims, and fully fund the replacement of the Key Bridge. If this month was any preview, we're in for a chaotic four years. But we still delivered key wins for the people of Maryland - from providing federal funding for the Key Bridge project to finally passing the Social Security Fairness Act. Here are some highlights: Keeping the Government Open to Serve Americans One of Congress's central responsibilities is to fund the federal government. And while we had a bipartisan compromise deal to do so, we hit a sudden snag with days to go. Elon Musk and Donald Trump sent House Republicans into a delay spiral - bringing us back to governing by tweet. Despite the Republican chaos that brought us dangerously close to a government shutdown just before the holidays, I'm glad we were able to reach an . This legislation will move the Key Bridge replacement forward while providing relief to other communities across the country hit by disasters. It also prevents a government shutdown, ensuring that federal employees can continue to provide the country with vital services and receive paychecks for the work they do on behalf of the American people. That being said, I was disappointed that once again our Republican colleagues chose a short-term patch, instead of passing a year-long funding bill that would truly meet the shifting priorities of our nation and our state. This means that come March, we'll once again need to work towards a long-term spending bill, where I'll continue fighting to deliver for Maryland. We also achieved other bipartisan priorities in the final weeks. That included passing the annual National Defense Authorization Act, legislation that invests in our military installations and the men and women of our armed forces and is important to maintaining our national security. While there were many things within this legislation I did not support, as it will support our servicemembers - including a significant pay raise for junior enlisted members - as well as our local Maryland installations. We also passed the Social Security Fairness Act, bipartisan legislation I cosponsored, to ensure public sector workers and their families can receive full Social Security benefits. For over forty years, a pair of laws from the 70s and 80s have reduced Social Security benefits for public workers, from first responders to teachers to food safety inspectors. These workers paid into Social Security for their entire lives; it's just plain wrong for them to receive anything less than full benefits. For years, we're been trying to fix this issue. This bill will secure full Social Security benefits for 3 million Americans, including over 54,000 Marylanders. They served our country. They deserve to retire with dignity. I'm also proud to report that the Senate unanimously passed our Chesapeake National Recreation Act. This legislation, which Congressman Sarbanes and I introduced after a months-long public feedback process, would unite voluntarily contributed park areas and Bay properties as a national recreation area under the National Park Service. This will help the Bay get more federal resources to conserve our environment, celebrate our Bay history and culture, and support sustainable economic opportunity. The Chesapeake Bay is both a Maryland and a national treasure, and it deserves to be recognized as such. While there was not enough time to get a vote on the bill in the House before adjournment, we have built tremendous momentum - which should help us get it adopted in the next Congress. Rebuilding the Key Bridge For 47 years, the Key Bridge has been a vital thoroughfare for the Baltimore region and national commerce. It carried over 34,000 travelers a day, and stood as the gateway to the Port of Baltimore, which each year welcomes 1,800 ships, supports over 27,000 local jobs, and generates $70 billion in revenue. When the bridge collapsed, it was not only a local tragedy, but a national one. We lost six Baltimore construction workers who were working the overnight shift. Thousands of longshoremen were temporarily put out of work or faced greatly diminished hours. Every small business and industry that depended on the Port of Baltimore faced disruptions. And today, many communities and Marylanders are impacted by the burden of taking longer, more congested routes without the Key Bridge. But as the bridge came apart, we came together. A heroic officer of the Maryland Transportation Authority stopped traffic from crossing the bridge moments before it collapsed, saving lives, and other first responders saved two workers who survived the collapse. President Biden directed the Coast Guard to lead a Unified Command of local, state, and federal agencies. It was a whole-of-government effort: I'm grateful to Governor Moore, Mayor Scott, County Executive Olszewski, and every other leader who stepped up. Senator Cardin, Congressman Mfume and I worked with Team Maryland to continue the federal response - we quickly secured emergency highway funding to aid in the recovery effort. Members of the Unified Command recovered the bodies of six fallen construction workers, then worked rapidly to clear the debris from the shipping channel and re-open the Port of Baltimore in just 11 weeks. While work on the ground was underway, we were also busy in Congress fighting to shore up the support Maryland needed to secure full federal funding to rebuild the bridge. In April, Senator Cardin, Congressman Mfume, and I, joined by the full Team Maryland, introduced bipartisan, bicameral legislation to secure 100% federal funding for the replacement. Our bill also ensured that any proceeds from insurance claims or litigation would go back to the federal taxpayers. Time and again, we have supported other states in their times of great need, so we argued, now it was time for these states to have our back as well. After much drama, they came through and embraced the time-honored American spirit of helping neighbors in their hour of need. PSA: Protect Your Family from Online Scams One danger we all face is online scams - right now, my team is hearing from more and more Marylanders ensnared by fraud. There are tech support scams, in which criminals pose as tech support representatives to gain access to victims' computers, and investment fraud, in which fraudsters lure their victims with a seemingly lucrative investment plan. The scammers are growing more sophisticated every day, many using cryptocurrency to funnel your money overseas and make it almost impossible to get it back. In some cases, they slowly build trust with their intended targets online, posing as a new friend or even a romantic interest. To stay safe, don't share sensitive personal or financial information online, especially with someone you've never met in real life. Maryland saw almost 2,000 reported victims in 2023, losing around $72.4 million. Many more have not come forward. To protect yourself from scams, the FBI says that your best defense is "healthy skepticism." Scammers want you to react quickly; always remember to slow down. If you get a suspicious message, don't respond immediately - take a beat. To learn more about staying safe, . If you believe you may be the target of a scam, you can file a complaint by . I'm also working to take action in Congress to help tackle this issue. To protect Americans from fraud, I've authored bipartisan legislation that would help crack down on scams. Our bill, the , would give states more resources to investigate scammers, upgrade technology, enhance training, and raise public awareness of the latest threats. Whether it's on one of these issues - or dozens of others - my office is always ready to serve Marylanders and provide assistance. . Don't hesitate to reach out if we can ever be of service. Our Thanks to Senator Cardin Senator Cardin has been a great friend and wonderful partner in the U.S. Senate. we prepared in his honor. And Thank You! It's clear that the year ahead will present new challenges. In all the battles to come, I'll be glad to have Team Maryland - especially my new partner, Senator-elect Angela Alsobrooks - working with me on behalf of all Marylanders and our fellow Americans. And thank you for being fully engaged in advancing our great American experiment in democracy. Together, we will work to ensure that our brightest days are still ahead. Happy New Year!
