body:
2025 Legislative Plan - Part Two - TAXES! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/2edfcc9f7e5d/n41kepo7ku-12725567?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7b44a0e6a0&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

I started my very first newsletter comparing a commonality that many people have to the routines and components of a day, such as drinking coffee. As I write this email nearing the end of 2024, we must pause and give consideration to those that this will be the first Christmas/holiday season with a drastic life change to the traditions of this time of year and are much more difficult.

A loved one lost. A soldier family member overseas. A job loss. A separation or divorce. Sickness or injuries.

_"Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God."_
**\--Colossians 3:1**
* * *
Virtues. Tradition. Commonalities. It really is a Good Life filled with opportunities in Nebraska.

However, something just feels off. The challenge is we naturally apply _subjective truths_ _(truth that is based off of perspective, feelings, or opinions)_ as to WHAT and WHY we think things are troubling. Contrary, **OBJECTIVE truths** (measured and calculated truth devoid of emotion) take communication and a genuine desire (filled with empathy and sympathy towards others) to seek solutions.

Empathy and sympathy have to come from the heart and soul of the leaders in Nebraska. And without communication, discussion, debate, discourse, even with disagreement...then what we are seeing is a disconnect.

The disconnect happens when people don't feel heard or even like they are given an opportunity to be heard. Later today will be an email with results from our **Truth in Taxation** Survey. I've read every response on the "open text box" portion of the survey...and...it's very troubling seeing so many Nebraskans suffering. **Property Taxes NEED reduced, PERIOD!**
We must be the voice of the people and utilize the **2025 Legislative Plan** to build relationships to the Unicameral Senators producing effective solutions for ALL Nebraskans.

The integrity of the Unicameral is in the effectiveness to purposefully and meaningfully benefit Nebraskans, NOT a select few special interests. Any inhibition to Unicameral Rules change is for the purposeful and meaningful benefit of those who PROFIT during elections. If no purposeful and meaningful changes occur in law-making, EVERY election cycle has an INCREASING financial benefit and a perceived "THIS TIME"... "If you elect me, THIS TIME, I promise to..."
**NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY
LEGISLATIVE PLAN FOR NEBRASKA
109th Legislature, 1st Regular Session, 2025**
_MODERNIZE NEBRASKA LEGISLATIVE RULES TO REFLECT
“WE THE PEOPLE”_ The integrity of the Nebraska Unicameral has been eroded by outdated rules that do not promote best practices for legislation and the needs of its citizens. It is way overdue for legislators to change their procedural rules to make the legislative process fairer and more efficient.

The integrity of the Unicameral is in the effectiveness to purposefully and meaningfully benefit Nebraskans. Any inhibition to Rules change is for the purposeful and meaningful benefit of those who PROFIT during elections. If no purposeful and meaningful changes occur in law-making, EVERY election cycle has INCREASING financial benefit and a perceived "THIS TIME"... "If you elect me, THIS TIME, I promise to..."
* **Lower the Cloture Vote Threshold**
* Advocate for lowering the cloture vote threshold in the Nebraska Legislature to facilitate smoother passage of key legislative initiatives, ensuring that important bills are not indefinitely stalled by minority obstruction. **Change the cloture vote requirement to 3/5's (30)**. The number to override a Governor or a minority group in the legislature should be the same.

_MAKE A STRONG ECONOMY THAT WORKS FOR ALL NEBRASKANS_ Economic success is fueled by the drive of free men and women aspiring to achieve their dreams, provide for their families, and further prosperity for their communities. Our Nation declared its independence to fight back against an overbearing government that subordinated the freedom and prosperity of individual citizens. Our founders sought to unleash the power of entrepreneurship and free enterprise. We seek legislation that will grow our state’s economy and provide hope and prosperity lifting up families and communities across the state.
* **Comprehensive Property Tax Reform**
* Develop and promote property tax legislation that **reduces** the financial burden on Nebraskans. Proposals will include assessment caps and increased state funding to local governments to reduce dependency on property taxes.
* **Taxable** amounts to property valuations will need to be reduced. NOT the valuations themselves but the taxable amount. We must think BOLDLY and consider all residential, commercial, agricultural, & horticultural property support to give EVERYONE a property tax reduction.
* Property Tax Reduction: The reduction in taxable property valuations will provide immediate and significant relief to property owners across Nebraska, easing the financial burden on families, businesses, and farmers.
* Economic Growth: Lower property taxes will create a more business-friendly environment, encouraging investment and economic development in Nebraska.
* Fiscal Responsibility: Encourage sound financial management at both the state and local levels. Taxing Authorities will be encouraged to use resources more efficiently with the reduced reliance on property tax revenue, promoting thoughtful budgeting and effective use of funds.

_THE FUTURE OF NEBRASKA IS IN CHILDREN’S EDUCATION_
Republicans CARE for students and teachers.
* **Support policies that rebuild the commitment and focus to the basics of education**
* Support for Teachers: Support educators but also strengthen the commitment to students and the 23,000 teachers in Nebraska. Ensure that Nebraska's educators are fairly compensated in ALL 244 school systems, leading to better educational outcomes and community development.
* Preserve parents right to see all curriculum materials in every class their child attends.
* Set standards allowing parents to protect children from indoctrination and pornography.
* Protect privacy in school bathrooms to respect biological gender.
* Call for the Enforcement of the American Civics clause of Nebraska statute
## [79-724](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2b70119ca9&e=25844e23a8)
### Committee on American civics; created; duties; school board, State Board of Education, and superintendent; duties.
_It is the responsibility of society to ensure that youth are given the opportunity to become competent, responsible, patriotic, and civil citizens to ensure a strong, stable, just, and prosperous America. Such a citizenry necessitates that every member thereof be knowledgeable of our nation's history, government, geography, and economic system. The youth in our state should be committed to the ideals and values of our country's democracy and the constitutional republic established by the people. Schools should help prepare our youth to make informed and reasoned decisions for the public good. Civic competence is necessary to sustain and improve our democratic way of life and must be taught in all public, private, denominational, and parochial schools. A central role of schools is to impart civic knowledge and skills that help our youth to see the relevance of a civic dimension for their lives. Students should be made fully aware of the liberties, opportunities, and advantages we possess and the sacrifices and struggles of those through whose efforts these benefits were gained. Since young people are most susceptible to the acceptance of principles and doctrines that will influence them throughout their lives, it is one of the first duties of our educational system to conduct its activities, choose its textbooks, and arrange its curriculum in such a way that the youth of our state have the opportunity to become competent, responsible, patriotic, and civil American citizens._

Moving into 2025, the leaders of this party will be tasked to speak boldly in newspapers, and radio, and mailings, and social media of OUR Republican principles. We will connect with Nebraskans to develop and create a CLEAR picture as to the Values of the Republican Party of Nebraska. We will engage MORE voters or REGISTER more voters to purposefully INFLUENCE the outcomes of future elections. We will set forth the election changes that match President Trump's mandate for securing your voice each and EVERY election. **WE HAVE A PLAN!**
We have driven and determined leaders across this state that will be implementing our Legislative Plan, are forthcoming Political Plan, and returning the influence BACK to the party and away from consultants that are only driven by money and power.

The truth shall set us free.

Blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood
---
| | This was the VISION and OBJECTIVE TRUTHS of 2024...nothing changes without YOU.
2025 NEGOP VISION
In 2025, the Republican Party of Nebraska is going ALL-IN on the VALUES of Education, ALL-IN on Election Accountability and Voter Verification, ALL-IN on Tax Reform, ALL-IN on Protecting Human Rights. This will come to fruition in our Legislative Plan and through the voices of the people who will expect the very most from their elected representatives. The groundwork has been completed and in 2025 it will all come down to a choice by EVERY Republican. The choice is to remove oneself from the party politics and personalities normally associated with power and money AND engage at the doorstep of Nebraskans sharing the truth of our values because our values bring the solutions to local struggles of taxes, community safety, election security, & educational excellence. The Values of the Republican Party resonate with Nebraskans. We are reaching out and connecting in 2025 and this will be a victory for Conservative Principles.

Nebraskans are thirsting for people of courage, people of honesty and truth...they are hungry for leaders to say what they are going to do...AND...then DO what they say! I am beyond measure proud of the Republican grassroots and coalitions. They HAVE created stability within this organization.

Every false narrative sowing chaos is an attempt by those who seek their power back. The Republicans who prioritize our principles are actively fulfilling the objectives of the party by doing maintenance of the government of, by, and for the people AND furthering their principles within the community. And this effort will continue to grow and grow as more principled Republicans join the efforts. I see this growth and stability EVERYWHERE in Nebraska now. Dixon County, Seward County, Gage County, York County, Sarpy County, Saline County, Madison, Keith, Hall, and on and on...and the growth and stability is coming FROM the people. From leaders of the party, who CHOOSE to grow and build their counties because the people matter and connecting people to our values matters. Common Nebraskans, who say enough is enough...who choose to sacrifice their time to become better every day and engage more volunteers to make more engagement opportunities. From County Chairs and Secretaries, committeemen and women, elected officials to candidates, they SEE the reality of what strong, healthy County Parties can do. These next 3-4 months there will be a purposeful and respectful focus of engagement to demographics and people who share conservative values. We are going ALL-IN on to be a resource for local campaigns and local elected positions such as school boards, city council, county seats, NRD's, power boards. We are going ALL-IN on people of Nebraska who make Nebraska the ‘Good Life’. –Chairman Underwood

name: Mohan Seshadri
subject: Thank you for an amazing year!
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Happy new year Peter!
We are so happy that you are a part of our community!
In 2024, we built a movement to save Philadelphia's Chinatown, to pass meaningful mental health legislation in Pennsylvania, and make sure everyone could make their voice heard in our national elections. We are building lasting Asian American political power at every level of government so that we can fight for what our communities truly need to be safe, healthy, and strong.
There is going to be a lot more work we will need to do in 2025 to protect our people. But for now, we want to end the year by thanking you for everything you did with us in 2024 because we could not do any of this without you.
You can make one final show of support for our work this year by donating to API PA so that we can finish the year strong. [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/donate?am=20.00&contactdata=rZRVxj6Q8gdshqhICnl5gKAETkzzlUX/DhvmlmBHRlw5jw1zHdQcGQsTngvTYQrWAGcdko1myFeL6hHEJgd2SP/Aofb4yGQchJOfiJeSwVOYo9ZZVcXG0HrdJRrwJbu6XCZz565KhzvQwxw0p/5U2xQdRN+dnMzG4aamEHhSP+k=] And stay tuned - we'll be reaching out soon to tell you about more how you can help protect our communities in 2025.
[https://www.apipennsylvania.org/donate?am=20.00&contactdata=rZRVxj6Q8gdshqhICnl5gKAETkzzlUX/DhvmlmBHRlw5jw1zHdQcGQsTngvTYQrWAGcdko1myFeL6hHEJgd2SP/Aofb4yGQchJOfiJeSwVOYo9ZZVcXG0HrdJRrwJbu6XCZz565KhzvQwxw0p/5U2xQdRN+dnMzG4aamEHhSP+k=]
Happy new year,
Mohan Seshadri

Hi Peter,

We are just hours away from a brand new year, so we’ve spent some time reflecting on our hopes for the women and girls of our nation in 2025.

**We hope for a better experience for women in America:** For many women in our country, the issues they deal with are often ignored. Things like violence against women, sexual harassment, unaffordable childcare, menopause... and, yes, reproductive healthcare. When men (even men with the BEST of intentions) make up the majorities in the rooms where important decisions are being made, women’s issues are not given adequate attention. **That is why we need more women’s voices in these important conversations.**

**We hope to draw closer to gender parity in government:** In states across the country, majority-male GOP legislatures are passing draconian laws that discount women’s health, safety, and rights to bodily autonomy. The vast majority of _the people making critical decisions about**women’s** bodies_ are MEN. That needs to change – which is why Her Bold Move exists.

**2025 will be a year that tests us. It will test our patience, our determination, and our commitment to a better country. We’ve said it before and we’ll say it again: we must keep up the fight. Women have made SO MUCH PROGRESS over the last century. We must defend that hard-fought progress on behalf of our mothers, our grandmothers, our daughters, and our friends.**

Cheers to 2025! I hope you are ready to ring in the new year with as much excitement as I am! Texans for Vaccine Choice is ready to get to work. Are you ready to join us? I know it’s New Year’s Eve, and everyone is in party mode, but before you pop the bubbly, please take a quick second to consider donating to TFVC!

| | | [ Give to Texans For Vaccine Choice! ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQyMjQzMTI0MTcxNzY5NzA1LFwiclwiOjE0MjI0MzE3Mjc4Mzc1MjMzOH0iLCJzIjoiMDY2ZDU0OGNkZTViNzgxMiJ9)
---
|
---
You have brought us so much joy this year by supporting our mission to protect Texans from medical tyranny. As I reflect on 2024, I can hardly believe all we accomplished in such a short time. But with so much at stake, we could not afford to slack off. From film premieres to testifying in Austin, TFVC was busy all year raising awareness and fighting for medical freedom. As we attended events all over the state, such as the Texas Republican Convention, the Texas Youth Summit, and the Texas Homeschool Convention, we met new, amazing people who each had a story to tell and a talent to share. Many such friends have become TFVC Outreach Coordinators, helping TFVC spread the message and grow our organization. _Check out our Year in Review Video for a sampling of our 2024 highlights_!
|
---
| [ ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQyMjQzMTI0MTc4MDYxMTkzLFwiclwiOjE0MjI0MzE3Mjc4Mzc1MjMzOH0iLCJzIjoiYjNiYTY1Njg3NjUxYmVjMyJ9)
---
|
---
All of these efforts have had an enormous impact! Not only did we expand and strengthen the vaccine choice plank of the RPT Platform, but medical liberty was ranked in the top 8 legislative priorities! And at the ballot box, many of our vaccine choice champions won their races in the primary and general elections. Of course, we would be remiss if we did not mention Donald Trump's historic election! TFVC is incredibly optimistic about this administration, especially with Trump’s appointment of RFK Jr. as Secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services. Let’s MAHA! As TFVC begins its tenth year of fighting for Texans, we ask that you join our mission today by [making an end-of-year donation](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQyMjQzMTI0MTg1NDAxMjYyLFwiclwiOjE0MjI0MzE3Mjc4Mzc1MjMzOH0iLCJzIjoiMTAxOTM0ZDQ5ZTk0ODYxMiJ9)! Thank you for contributing to a healthier future for Texas!

|
---
| | | **Cheers!

** **Rebecca Hardy** **President, TFVC**

From: A.G. Holder
Date: Thurs, Dec 26, 2024
Subject: It's not the time for acceptance and resignation

Next month, Donald Trump and a radical Republican-led federal government will take office.
For much of his first presidency, Trump’s incompetence tended to mitigate somewhat the impact of his malevolence. But he still managed to seriously damage our democracy because many of the checks in our Constitution simply didn’t work. The Supreme Court, his attorneys general, the Senate and the House signed off on key pillars of a dangerous, anti-democracy agenda and always failed to hold him accountable.
**Given this, one thing is abundantly clear headed into Trump’s second term: The only check left on his power is us. It’s the power of the people: a power that is too often underestimated and too infrequently used.**
**This is not a time for acceptance and resignation — this is the time for commitment and action.**
[**So today I am personally asking you to donate to the NDRC before the end of the year to help us to do the hard, and absolutely necessary work of defending our democracy — help protect fair maps, combat ongoing gerrymandering, and prepare for the redistricting battles coming our way.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99565905/520316791/1701676424?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_email_20241231-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241231-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_&utm_campaign=AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI0YTJiOTg2LTdmYzctZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EreDWeoFiK1eo0u-SwJz7oAos5C8NJFrIaTz8o7G4BU=)
The Trump Republican Party just isn’t that into democracy — because their priority isn’t respecting the will of the people; it’s accruing the power to implement their agenda that caters to the special interests and perpetuates their illegitimate political control.
Want a recent example? Last month in North Carolina, in a lame duck legislative session and over the governor’s veto, Republicans added anti-democracy provisions (in a disaster relief bill!) that will take power away from the Democratic governor and give it to the newly elected Republican auditor. They are also attempting to restrict the ability of the incoming Democratic Attorney General to legally oppose any measures they might pass. It’s clear that Republicans care more about political control than getting needed relief to hurricane victims in the state. It’s also clear that they are willing to break our democracy to keep power they illegitimately hold.
**In the long run, the history of American democracy has always been one of grinding, halting, uneven success — even in the face of tyranny. So it must be again.**
Here’s the thing, though: We have to work for it. The path to progress has never been blazed through inertia. The NDRC has a strong 10 Year Plan. We know these efforts are paying off, and we know how to execute — we just need to make sure we have the financial resources to fund this work.
[**No matter how it feels today, it remains true: A better future is in reach, as long as we’re willing to fight for it. Are you with me? If so, please consider making a contribution.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99565906/520316792/1701676424?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_email_20241231-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241231-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR_&utm_campaign=AGEOYMatchLiftnoteNOR&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI0YTJiOTg2LTdmYzctZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EreDWeoFiK1eo0u-SwJz7oAos5C8NJFrIaTz8o7G4BU=)

Friend,

I am reaching out to you personally today to ask for your re-commitment and support in sustaining our collective work in 2025 and beyond.

Power will be built in the struggle in 2025. Approaching the new year, I think about our staff who are community leaders from within the neighborhoods we center. As trusted messengers, they have engaged in thousands of meaningful conversations with their friends and neighbors around the importance of engaging in the democratic process. As a second chance organization that hires, coaches and mentors some staff members who are formerly incarcerated, or experiencing mental health issues, or are currently in recovery, I’m honored to lead a dedicated staff who are able to do meaningful and important work and earn a living wage with benefits. As we approach the new year, I reflect on all the Pennsylvanians I met on the ground whose lives quite literally have been changed knowing they are able to vote, that their voices matter, and their votes were counted.

In my travels across the Commonwealth, I often carry around a posterboard of one of my personal civil rights icons, civil rights activist and West Chester native, Bayard Rustin that states, “The proof that one truly believes is in action.” The New PA Project Education Fund is fully committed to year-round voter engagement and civic education across PA and will continue to take action in standing up for voting rights, and expanded access to the ballot to ensure Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth vote in every election, twice a year.

**A family foundation in Pittsburgh has pledged to match every dollar raised up to $25,000, meaning that if we hit our goal today, we can raise $50,000 to keep our work going.**

[**We are just beginning to witness the enduring impact our work will have on Pennsylvania for generations to come. **Engaging voters year-round:** Your gift supports year-round voter engagement efforts across the Commonwealth, centering Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth to ensure all eligible voters feel compelled to exercise their freedom to vote in the Commonwealth.

**Preparing for 2025:** In 2025, PA will elect judges and justices in partisan elections and participate in nonpartisan judicial retention elections, including three PA Supreme Court seats, which will undoubtedly make national news and attract dark money funders like PA’s richest man, Jeffrey Yaas to disrupt our judicial races. We need to make sure that our communities do not lose hope and turnout in 2025 for our local, municipal, and judicial elections.

**Defending against attacks on voting rights:** Attacks on voting rights will only continue as we head into the critical local, municipal, and judicial elections next year. # FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

subject: My final note to you this year

body:
It’s an honor to have you standing with me and the whole team here at GIFFORDS in our movement to end gun violence.
#

Friends, as we prepare to ring in the new year tonight, I wanted to send you one last note in 2024.
This was certainly a year filled with unprecedented and historic moments, and I am so grateful to each and every person in this community for answering our calls to action when we needed you the most.
Thank you, thank you, thank you. We truly could not do our lifesaving work without you.
Today is one of those days where I’m counting on your support. I know you’ve already received quite a few messages from my team about our FEC deadline tonight, but I needed to ask you personally: [**Will you please make a $5 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC before our critical end-of-year FEC fundraising deadline passes at midnight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec24.MAKoxe&refcode=em241231-1-b&t=1&akid=9742%2E3935704%2ETsGfVt)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec24.MAKoxe&refcode=em241231-1-b&t=2&akid=9742%2E3935704%2ETsGfVt)**
Once the clock strikes midnight, we’ll close the books on our fundraising for the entire year and will soon have to report our numbers publicly. Both the total amount we’ve raised and the number of individual contributions we’ve received all year will be released, so this is an important milestone.
Please know that your donation—whether it’s $5, $10 or more—directly fuels our fight to end gun violence. With the challenges we are going to face in 2025 and beyond, this FEC deadline is a chance for us to make sure we have the resources to start the new year off strong.

body:
How we're mobilizing NOW....
| | |
---
| | [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FoRuvADHNxCf94DLPDTwOIhXsWlZFOTvoxEv5rbTlViyVwaWErI5DQbu0B6_jwTW5TOPFfZ4fp954qkmrRfqZTMdDyttfbwaSoids7uyjuWeopgYOWLBJ_XeOOKUxVPBEUzKPT7O6FvpbCSwwI1QUt2ZKqXO5Ylwra2ckQcFwv9-_MLdVz0MbT8EBBlzSNE7SX9nFvDE9HkeAm44OLRJQA==&c=UbX2-uojysHIgORezX6Zh8lBOPkH-RFqJ7gi3skSuBb8T5MGlRxi8A==&ch=bPDoXwJaszHhRklblkRgkrv75G9YsgTiQPOgrJAAluX7dMlZ9w-xIA==)
---
| Friends,
In 1776, our founders could not have imagined how close we would come to losing everything they fought for--yet we nearly did. Obama and Biden pushed mass censorship, generational brainwashing, claims that there's no difference between boys and girls, funding enemies bent on killing us, and all with the help of the complicit mainstream media. They refused to enforce the law while our borders were invaded by drugs, rapists, and murderers.
Then they offered the invaders free healthcare and hotels.
---
| The left nearly destroyed America while putting their foot on the throat of the middle class by taxing US into oblivion. The elite took metaphorical shots at your livelihood while taking literal shots at President Donald Trump. WITH FISTS RAISED WE LET OUT OF A COLLECTIVE "FIGHT"
---
| And fight you did.
By stepping up and electing the businessman from New York, assisted by an immigrant electric car entrepreneur who plans to conquer Mars -- we pushed back against the tyranny of the left on our families, our pocketbooks, and our freedom.
---
| WE FOUGHT -- WE WON! Now ... We Make America Great Again. The founders would be proud of the historic 2024 election that saved the Republic they fought for.
---
Trump won with historic margins and a mandate. Our new goal is simple: SUPPORT THE MANDATE
Will you sign and support this effort?
---
| | [SUPPORT THE MANDATE](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FoRuvADHNxCf94DLPDTwOIhXsWlZFOTvoxEv5rbTlViyVwaWErI5DQ0JDoArOqg2BfaXyDTKsqbYq3ifDdAJ8qck4eDaLGuYf7TJieEjQCRy4jHAXntYeRfC7qWe3nBbP3T3tsSeTO5XF77rhRES5i_I0IYahwqIW-Tag7sF-OemHp1IK09GTzJirQHPaYARFHAX_v0qZiA1ILmr5EwFMgCXcIZJcOY1cFi-pfSZk7TdivdMHegw7F-s7gHWEa3V&c=UbX2-uojysHIgORezX6Zh8lBOPkH-RFqJ7gi3skSuBb8T5MGlRxi8A==&ch=bPDoXwJaszHhRklblkRgkrv75G9YsgTiQPOgrJAAluX7dMlZ9w-xIA==)
---
| Everyone at the American Principles Project stands ready for whatever 2025 brings. We have the team assembled, the tools ready, and a fire burning inside us all to fight like hell.

---
| At this very moment, Biden and Kamala are pulling last-minute tricks--pardoning criminals, writing blank checks to their friends, and actively working to hand Donald Trump an economic disaster, undermining American success for their political agenda.
---
| We won't let Americans be fooled. We will do everything we can in President Trump's first 100 days to support his mandate.
---
| Our Top Priorities right now: ● Defund gender ideology and racist DEI programs that target students and military families ● Protect girls' sports ● End transgender surgeries and drugs for kids ● Defund leftist attacks on the family through the DOGE committee
---
| To that end, we're launching a Rapid Response Campaign for the President's Pro-Family Agenda--a $1.67 million effort in January and the first 100 days of Trump's Presidency to SUPPORT THE MANDATE. We are hours away from the end of the year, and every dollar you give will help us reach our goal.
---
| We have to go on the attack. President Trump's executive orders will face fierce opposition from: ● Democratic scumbags who will lie, distort basic facts, and try to eliminate pro-family protections for Americans because they genuinely hate the America we know and love.
● Establishment Republican con artists who will try to sideline any culture-focused agenda so they can hide in their safe districts while helping their corporate overlords.
---
| In both cases, we will be an unapologetic attack dog, firing back every day on Capitol Hill immediately against leftist distortions online, in the media, and directly in key voting districts. We'll publicly expose and apply intense pressure on Republicans who ignore the clear mandate from the people who elected President Trump. Will you join us?
---
| SUPPORT THE MANDATE
---
| Have a Happy New Year!
Sincerely,
---

---
| Terry Schilling President American Principles Project

name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: What a year
body:
Peter, On the last day of 2024, I thought it appropriate to sit down and spend some time reflecting on the arc of the year.
|
---
| Peter, On the last day of 2024, I thought it appropriate to sit down and spend some time reflecting on the arc of the year. I had a feeling in my bones that it has been a good year, but as I’ve gone back through the details, I’m filled with gratitude and awe. The Common Sense Majority made itself heard to a magnitude that we never have before. **We called out quite a bit of BS.** It is part of our mission here, as we try to save the state from Left Wing Lunacy. ❌ We pulled back the curtain on the racket of ongoing gas tax hikes – and laid the thanks for this original and disastrous idea where it belongs: at the feet of the corrupt power-broker and former Senate President Steve Sweeney. ❌ We called Governor Murphy signing the “Freedom to Read Act” what it really is. The freedom to groom and expose minors to explicit material with impunity. ❌ We put the spotlight on Sean Spiller’s misuse of teacher dues to fund his political career and the many ways the NJEA is misusing the trust teachers place with them. ❌ We called out current “solutions” to affordable housing being imposed on communities for what it is: Government overreach, pure and simple. ❌ We demanded an end to the gravy train at NJ Transit as problems abound and audits are nowhere to be found. **We got louder** across social media and engaged you in doing the same. Calling out BS is a team effort! **We also shocked the nation** with an election night showing that still has pundits scratching their heads. READ my take on the shift and the formerly silent majority behind it [here](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/4520674744325df830feaa0049a3aa55/eJyNkM1uwkAMhN_F52xTErjkhhBCUSiHip6rJbGIafZHXoc2oLx7N23FqUhIPtnfzGh8BUGrrZQNFPAllyzLIQHGmjyhlZWzouufa7aYz_JZAh3Zjw273kNx_Vd8A6Z1ni-eE5DBY0T2r8tVVe4279tyV0XSa44ZD_pk85vP-mVZbmEc7xqjIVmfo3eAQrjHqVFDsZW8cRf5VsSHIk1rZ4yzAePUXX94cnxMpUUVqItiZfTJMcmgDtiSbZTFT3VCDjgEZdwZlTg14UzHVtKYq71H2_w9rcLhN338BrpKd7c=) >>

It’s time to kick out the lemons, as we like to say (check out the [One Less Lemon](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/ee6594bd46915dd72e481460d76b902f/eJyNj0ELgkAQhf_LnCVx1cveRERE8xB1jkUHWtLdZR0jE_97a0VdCrrO-943vBkIlVBUtMDhSjfGQvDAYiONREWpViSaR8riKAgDDzqpzrnVowE-fy2_gfUchnHkAU0GHbLfJWlZ1PmxKurSkUZY9-NPD_t4sm1SVLAsP8XYS8ouzj0AJzviuqiVbhUdbOf4E5Hhvq8VdjgMHfZabRrdu6YwBlX7ml3i9Owvd2e4YCI=) project here and look for our billboards and ads around the state!). It’s safe to say that 2025 promises to leave the pundits even more confused than they are now. Because chances are, they haven’t yet learned their lesson. Thankfully, the Common Sense Majority is here to stay. Thank YOU for being part of this movement. I’m truly grateful for you. That’s a wrap on 2024. I’ll see you in 2025! Let’s go. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

| Did you catch our previous email? If not, you can read it here now: We know (by “we,” I mean common sense New Jerseyans, not Hollywood, coastal elites or the mainstream media) that woke extremism is one major reason the Left lost big last Tuesday night. Taxpayer funding of sex-change surgeries for prison inmates. Pushing a sexual agenda on kindergartners. Biological men beating up women in athletics. It’s this type of woke extremism that so many common sense New Jerseyans rejected on Tuesday when Trump got closer to winning New Jersey than any Republican since 1992. Why? Because common sense is that a criminal’s gender transition (or really anyone’s) shouldn’t be the financial responsibility of the taxpayer. Common sense is that children should be children and that indoctrinating them with sexually explicit materials is abusive behavior. And that women shouldn’t be losing medals and scholarships to biological men – who were usually mediocre athletes at best before deciding to compete against women. That’s the “patriarchy” the Left should be worried about. So as we look to 2025 and saving New Jersey from Left Wing Lunacy in offices from top to bottom, have candidates on the Left learned anything? Will they be moving from wokism towards common sense to, if nothing else, save their political rears? If you look at gubernatorial candidate Sean Spiller, it’s clear they won’t. Sean Spiller, the President of the New Jersey Education Association (NJEA) has been the center of some controversy for funneling NJEA resources (i.e., teacher dues) to his political campaign. But that’s just the beginning. A few days ago, “Drag Queen Entertainment” posted this video of their presence and “Banned Book Story Time” at... the NJEA Convention. This is on top of convention calls for “queering the curriculum.” The convention theme – “Learning. Equity. Justice.” should have told us all we needed to know. The message at this convention for New Jersey educators? Pushing a sexual agenda on children is not only welcomed, but encouraged. This is grooming, plain and simple. And NJ educators shouldn’t have this agenda forced on them either, especially at a time when our students are struggling and they need to be focused on core academic subjects. This is all going on under President Spiller’s lead and it has his fingerprints all over it. He has all but said he’s running to force his NJEA agenda on the entire state of New Jersey. And let’s just call this like it is – crazy, and dangerous. If the commentary from media elites and leftist insiders is any indicator, Spiller won’t be alone in continuing to push a woke agenda. But unfortunately for them, my hunch is that common sense New Jerseyans aren’t going to take it in 2025 either. So what do we do? It’s simple. 1) Identify more members of the Common Sense Majority. 2) Recruit common sense candidates for the ballot at every level. 3) Get the Common Sense Majority out to vote in the Primary and the General. It might be a simple strategy, but it’s not going to be easy. We need all of us working together to grab back that megaphone and save our state. Here at the Common Sense Club, we want you to feel like this is your home. The place where you aren’t alone in saying “that’s nuts!” and the place where you can do something about the lunacy you see around you. So as you celebrate, make plans to get back in the fight with us because 2025 is just around the corner... Let’s go, Common Sense friends! For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader
---

Dear Friend,

It's New Year's Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

Since you're a generous person, I'm sure you've received a LOT of requests for donations from many worthy causes.

name: Rushern Baker III
subject: Together, We Can Build a Stronger Community
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93538/images/Yard%20Signs%20%28March%202022%29%20%2815%29.png]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rushern-baker-iii-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rushern-baker-iii-1]
Dear Friends and Neighbors,
I want to take a moment to acknowledge the challenges so many of us are facing right now. >From watching the prices of groceries rise, to worrying about carjackings, and feeling the strain of affording a new home or keeping up with mortgage and rent payments, I understand how tough these times have become. This message is for everyone in Prince George's County who believes we can create a better and brighter future together.
I’m Rushern Baker, and I had the privilege of serving as your County Executive from 2010 to 2018. Together, we achieved significant milestones: we reduced crime rates by 50%, grew our economy by over $11 billion, expanded healthcare access with a new hospital, and saw our property values soar. While those accomplishments are important, I recognize that what truly matters is how we improve your quality of life right now.
On March 4th, you’ll be faced with an important decision that will impact your community and your future. I know you want to live in a safe neighborhood, where crime doesn't overshadow your daily life. You deserve a government that listens and delivers on its promises, where you can access first-rate shopping and healthcare without the constant worry of financial burdens.
As we approach this election, I want to highlight that everyone will promise to deliver results for you, but I am the only candidate that has, and I’m committed to earning your trust and your vote. I invite you to follow my journey in this campaign, where our focus will always be on how we can serve you better. This election is not just about candidates; it’s about you and your needs.
I need your support on March 4th, I’m asking for your vote. And, if you can, please consider contributing to my campaign. I understand these are difficult times for many, so any amount you feel comfortable giving will make a real difference. Together, we will win and strive for a brighter future for our community.
Thank you for being part of this journey with me.
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rushern-baker-iii-1]
Warm regards,
Rushern L. Baker III
Candidate for County Executive
P.S. Let’s carry this momentum into the new year and hit our $100,000 goal! Your contribution of $25, $250, or $2,500 today will bring us closer to victory. Dear Friend,

It's New Year's Eve, and the clock is ticking because the end of 2024 is fast approaching. Tick tock...tick tock...

Since you're a generous person, I'm sure you've received a LOT of requests for donations from many worthy causes.

But I just had to send you this request to support our 2024 year-end campaign before the clock runs out. I wouldn't write you if the cause weren't so urgent and important.

Your giving is important to starting 2025 ready for our new **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** right out of the gate.

[Will you give to restore liberty by **reaching** and **teaching** millions in 2025?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ed9a86be4366414ea01f89a39f0c495e&_e=b0DQ11SDx4tiBITdd0uNVTBF1YemvZ1DwujsGCnLwq3NCt7BKaX5G8bwcanbnzXcC7Ki9jW12xpCkHLuRb5QrPRP6GgaeqU26qQXKueIdFkLCbowGFNrWUDxNh6ef0VwrmiJvY2UsDNUruTlO_8iDOKCd1UD6vRi1awQNDD-YbLbqTZ5leskM_fL1qvJQCBbZqkKB6TGf5hWtdf6P4CHShrrmGEbA3zAeNFv5Hom2UO74oWgqqraKi4eUVkulhyTnDHlnsws4lIAigLEFS_JnWyNFTjw-Nu9xpZZVAdjDG4-4Wt9SZilbtX627bwKlG12AoTQhTS3Oytq9-GEw3VUAm8zhN_eVB-D1WssbOKS0_XC__ZfRdCH9vFXTR8rh8_)

You and I both know that this is the surest way of protecting liberty in America--especially since you've seen how divided we are as a nation. And I'm sure you're as hopeful as I am about the prospects for liberty in 2025. That's one of the reasons for my urgency, in fact.

So, I'm counting on your help to implement our **Project to Revive and Restore Liberty Through Education** in 2025.

Your gift is especially needed because we refuse EVERY PENNY of taxpayer support--even indirect aid in the form of student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain independent and effective in the cause of liberty.

If you can help us then please **make your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $250 before midnight tonight using this secure link:**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ed9a86be4366414ea01f89a39f0c495e&_e=b0DQ11SDx4tiBITdd0uNVTBF1YemvZ1DwujsGCnLwq3NCt7BKaX5G8bwcanbnzXcC7Ki9jW12xpCkHLuRb5QrPRP6GgaeqU26qQXKueIdFkLCbowGFNrWUDxNh6ef0VwrmiJvY2UsDNUruTlO_8iDOKCd1UD6vRi1awQNDD-YbLbqTZ5leskM_fL1qvJQCBbZqkKB6TGf5hWtdf6P4CHShrrmGEbA3zAeNFv5Hom2UPB40GlubcbYtI_vIhYKePKNTMLQmM3A_HJYEoWHG6uG1OvDIMMNpt6B0RqTbNefROmwyLMRG8pDNn5lvbGFJCPmFswKi7TFfwq20WytNClz1uNv0S3JIAiybMT3Ku3ymmHdUXDW7WM1Hp3rp4EtqLi)

I am deeply thankful for your interest in Hillsdale College. Please allow me to wish you and yours a blessed, healthy, and prosperous New Year!

Gratefully,

-bill

body:
Thank you.
Happy New Year’s Eve!
As we get ready to ring in the new year, I want to thank you for being part of our incredible journey.
On Friday, I’ll be sworn in as a new member of the U.S. House of Representatives. It’s a moment I know I’ll never forget — one that I share with you, as someone who believes in the power of progress and helped make this possible.
As I prepare for this new, awe-inspiring chapter, I’m also focused on closing out this year on the strongest note possible. **Tonight at midnight marks the end of 2024. It also marks our last public fundraising deadline of the cycle.** It’s our chance to show the strength of this movement and make sure we’re ready for the tough work ahead in 2025.
[**So please, if you can, make a contribution before midnight by clicking this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241231-1?refcode=em20241231-1652&refcode2=1652_21716_J6-yon&akid=1652%2E21716%2EJ6-yon)
This isn’t about me — it’s about the issues we care about: **defending our democracy, making the American dream more affordable and accessible,_and_ protecting the most vulnerable among us.**
I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work, but I can’t do this alone. I need your help to keep our coalition strong enough to deliver real solutions that match the scale and scope of the challenges we’re facing.
[**So, with only a few hours left until midnight, will you make a contribution before we close out the year? Whether you can give $3 or $50, I’d be so grateful for your support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241231-1?refcode=em20241231-1652&refcode2=1652_21716_J6-yon&akid=1652%2E21716%2EJ6-yon)
Every contribution — _no matter the amount_ — sends a powerful message to those betting against us and helps fight for the values we share.
Thank you again. Here’s to a new year!
With gratitude,
Sarah McBride

Friends,
As the confetti settles and the calendar turns to 2025, I want to take a moment to reflect on the journey we’ve shared and the incredible momentum we’ve built together.
From the first door knocked to the last phone call made, your unwavering belief in this movement has inspired me every single day.
This past year was filled with challenges, but it was also a testament to the power of unity and determination.
We showed the world what happens when everyday people come together to stand up for what’s right.
We may not have achieved everything we set out to, but we made undeniable progress and laid the foundation for the incredible work ahead.
And speaking of what’s ahead – I am so excited to share that we’re gearing up for a HUGE announcement to kick off the new year.
(I know I’ve been teasing this for awhile now but I want to make sure everything is just right – and trust me, it will be worth the wait!)
Our focus will be squarely on hampering ULTRA-MAGA and Jim Jordan, holding them accountable for their reckless agendas, and ensuring they face the scrutiny they deserve.
It’s going to set the tone for a 2025 filled with bold actions, community aid, and more opportunities to make history together.
Will you chip in now to ensure you’re among the first to hear what’s next? Let’s start the year with a bang and show the world that this movement is only getting stronger. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20241231_eoy_message_link]
Here’s to a new year filled with hope, progress, and the unshakable belief that together, through strength, resilience, and sheer determination we will achieve our goals.
Wishing you and your loved ones health, happiness, and success in the year ahead.
Let’s make 2025 a year to remember!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

I always knew Ritchie was going places, but I never imagined one of those places would be the U.S. House.

His path to Congress wasn’t a traditional one. **He was raised by me, a working, single mother who often supported a family of four on a $4.25 minimum wage.**

Ritchie doesn’t have a college degree, and he never relied on fancy donors or affluent connections to get him to where he is today.

**My son was able to connect with and captivate New York families because he understands their struggles — we often lived them ourselves, Peter.**

And I know that those experiences drive him _every single time_ he walks into his office in D.C.

[Peter, I know I’m biased, but there is truly no better person than Ritchie to represent NY-15. So if you can afford it, today I’m hoping you could make a $3 donation to continue supporting him. name: Eric Teetsel
subject: We’ve had an incredible year
body:
Happy New Year! As we step into the next year, I’m filled with gratitude for all we’ve accomplished together. We’ve had an incredible year. Through... | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10707547?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | | [ ](http://)
---
| | | Friends,

Happy New Year! As we step into the next year, I’m filled with gratitude for all we’ve accomplished together. We’ve had an incredible year. Throughout 2024, CRA has been hard at work acting as the intellectual and policy nerve center of the America First movement.

We tackled some of the biggest issues our country is facing. We developed and mainstreamed **[legal arguments and justifications](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=76c6203ce1&e=17913c7d6d)** for declaring an invasion to end the border crisis. We’ve led the way on advancing**[trade policy](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3d850456a7&e=17913c7d6d)** that puts America First and revitalizes our economy. We’ve made the case for ending endless wars and shifting the burden of NATO to European nations.

We also **[released](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=952e13aba8&e=17913c7d6d)** a documentary “Fearless at the Point of Attack: The Jeff Clark Story” which exposed how partisan actors targeted Trump administration DOJ official Jeff Clark for daring to question the 2020 election.

Our efforts are getting noticed. We were proud to join President Trump at Mar-a-Lago in November, and he reiterated his support for our America First policy work.
---
|
---
| Help us continue to fight for the America First agenda by [making a generous contribution and helping us reach our end-of-year fundraising goal](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1581c619ee&e=17913c7d6d).

The truth is, the Center’s work has never been more important. Our team is working diligently on advancing several policies which will help us push back against the woke and weaponized administrative state.

My Center colleagues have written about the [power of impoundment](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=58b0173c2f&e=17913c7d6d) which gives the president the ability to decline to spend the full amount of money that Congress appropriates for projects. They have also produced a critical [brief](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=4e273fb3c8&e=17913c7d6d) along with a [deeper dive](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0858bf53f3&e=17913c7d6d) on the power of recess appointments, which allow a president to quickly staff his administration without delay.

You will be hearing from the CRA team more in the fights ahead, but for now, I wanted to personally thank you for all that you’ve done for the Center and for our country. [And please consider a generous contribution to our cause](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=8bd7f71c00&e=17913c7d6d).

The coming years are certain to be a crucial time for our country. Now the real work begins.

Thank you in advance for [your support](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=fea21cf340&e=17913c7d6d). Your generosity has made all this possible and we’re incredibly grateful to have you on our side.

Sincerely,

Eric Teetsel
Executive Vice President, Center for Renewing America

# 🎉 Ring in the New Year with Us—and Make History!

| To my dear supporters,

As we prepare to welcome 2025, I want to take a moment to thank you. This past year has been rough - but we all stick together. Never let the conservative movement make you give up - never let them make you too tired to fight. Your support and belief in our vision for Colorado’s 5th district has been nothing short of inspiring. Together, we’ve proven that change is possible—even in the face of steep challenges.
Every dollar you give today makes a statement about the strength and resolve of our campaign.
---
[Donate before midnight](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=163ca53d95&e=3818d77efc)

As we count down to 2025, let’s celebrate not only the new year but also the hope we’re bringing to Colorado Springs. Thank you for standing with me—we couldn’t do this without you.
Here’s to a year of growth, opportunity, and progress. Together, we’ll make it happen.
With gratitude and determination
River Gassen

| I have a personal ask, Peter. My LAST public filing deadline of 2024 is tonight, and we’re still $10,000 short of our End of Year goal. That doesn’t work – so I’ve got to ask for your help getting over the line. Every dollar is accounted for in our 2025 plans, so we really can’t fall short. It’s us against fascism in a fight to organize, mobilize, and keep me fighting in Congress. I cannot do this without you. [**_Will you please chip in $27 today to help hit this final End of Year goal so we can keep our movement strong in the New Year? >>_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/CxAC_aanvse4Km2r4L_oXw~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRpVpaNP0TJaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDI0MTIzMV9lbV9mcl9iMV9lb3kyMDI0X2VuJmFtb3VudD0yNyZjZG1jPTJxZzlZcU84WDU5MkJzZU9qeGUxTXpTeEJxMSZyZWZjb2RlMj0ycWc5WXFPOFg1OTJCc2VPanhlMU16U3hCcTEmcmVmY29kZWNkbWM9MnFnOVlxTzhYNTkyQnNlT2p4ZTFNelN4QnExVwNzcGNCCmdljRF0Z7HYSfJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAABp) Listen, Peter. I’m not a typical Representative. I was in school more recently than most members of Congress’ _kids_ were. I don’t have millionaire friends, or connections to big donors. I got here by relying on everyday people, and together, we built a movement, dollar by dollar. Peter,

Happy New Year’s Eve! As we enter the final hours of 2024, I find myself reflecting on my journey to Congress, which has been somewhat unconventional.

When my husband and I were both working full-time, and our boys were young, I would get off the night shift at the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to their classrooms to volunteer.

I couldn’t help but notice the students, especially Black and brown kids, were being underserved. **So, I did everything I could as a volunteer to ensure no student was left behind — but I knew I had to run for School Board to make a lasting difference.**

On the School Board, I fought tooth and nail for better funding for our schools. But eventually, **I knew I had to run for Orange County Commissioner to make critical changes.**

As Orange County Commissioner, I championed the construction of two schools, two senior centers, and affordable housing initiatives — **but, eventually, I knew the next step to securing long-term progress for our children’s and communities’ future was running for State House.**

**All these twists and turns culminated in me representing my home district in Congress, Peter.** I got into this line of work in pursuit of building a better life for my community and followed my heart throughout every single step.

[There’s still SO much more I can do. When my husband and I were both working full-time, and our boys were young, I would get off the night shift at the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to their classrooms to volunteer. I couldn’t help but notice the students, especially Black and brown kids, were being underserved. So, I did everything I could as a volunteer to ensure no student was left behind — but I knew I had to run for School Board to make a lasting difference. On the School Board, I fought tooth and nail for better funding for our schools. But eventually, I knew I had to run for Orange County Commissioner to make critical changes. As Orange County Commissioner, I championed the construction of two schools, two senior centers, and affordable housing initiatives — but, eventually, I knew the next step to securing long-term progress for our children’s and communities’ future was running for State House. All these twists and turns culminated in me representing my home district in Congress, Peter. I got into this line of work in pursuit of building a better life for my community and followed my heart throughout every single step. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = I’m so grateful to have you alongside me on this journey, Peter. — Valerie | = Paid for by Foushee for Congress Valerie Foushee for Congress PO Box 16446 Chapel Hill, NC 27516 United States If you would like to unsubscribe, You can also =.

The only way we can get there is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. If you can, will you make a $3 contribution — or $5, or anything you can — right now? Team AOC

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/99581313/520361227/892807758?refcode=MTFC_20241231_EMPET_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjViYjVlMy04ZWM3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDIyNDgyYTkzYWYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vl5GAHF_KTuKbB-JMSgcrRGUQKN9frEQIErdig6BS00=&emci=f4b7fc65-abc0-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=665bb5e3-8ec7-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=18839602) Working with students and their parents has still been the most rewarding part of my decades in public service.

**_Let me be as abundantly clear_ : abolishing the Department of Education would be a disaster– for our students, for our teachers, for parents, for our economy, and for our future.**

Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies want to dismantle public education in this country. Top to bottom, inside and out, they want to gut education and force working families to pay more taxes for less.

name: Ryan Mackenzie
subject: Happy New Year! And with the new year comes big news…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mackenzie For Congress]()
body:
| | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | This Friday, I will be officially sworn in to Congress and start representing the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley in Congress. Unfortunately, due to space and time considerations at the Capitol, it is impossible to invite all who have reached out to attend. That is why we will be holding a special swearing-in celebration on January 10th in the Lehigh Valley. I will share more details on that with you very soon.
Today, I am happy to announce my committee assignments and my office’s leadership team.
When approached by Congressional Leadership regarding committee assignments, I told them I will always work to make life more affordable for all Americans, secure our nation’s border, and work toward ending the chaos around the world - regardless of which committee assignments I received.
I did ask, however, to be seated on the Education and Workforce, Homeland Security, and Foreign Affairs committees. I am happy to announce that I was assigned all three of these important committees, and I look forward to bringing forth positive change that helps the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley and America.
I am also happy to announce my office’s leadership team. These are the people who will help me best represent you and ensure that the residents of the 7th District receive the help they deserve.
---
|
---
| **Chief of Staff: Julia Hearthway**
Julia Hearthway is returning to Washington DC to serve as Chief of Staff for Congressman Ryan Mackenzie. She is honored to be a part of Mackenzie’s team and excited to play a role in making the government work "for the people" once again. Julia has known Ryan for over a decade and she recognizes he is among a new generation of leaders that America needs to get the country back on track. She knows he will fight for our future and always stand up for our freedoms and values.
Julia previously served in the first Trump Administration as Director of the Office of Workers Compensation Programs at the U.S. Department of Labor (2017-2021). Prior to that appointment, she served as an Appellate Court Judge for the Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania (2016-2017) and as Pennsylvania’s Secretary of Labor and Industry (2011-2015).
---
|
---
| **Deputy Chief of Staff: Andres Weller**
Andres Weller will be serving as Deputy Chief of Staff to Congressman Ryan Mackenzie.
Andres most recently served as the Campaign Manager for the Mackenzie for Congress campaign. He also previously served as a Legislative Aide for State Representative Ryan Mackenzie.
He is excited to get to work to help deliver results for seniors and working families in the Greater Lehigh Valley.
---
|
---
| **District Director: Paige Riegner**
Paige Riegner will be serving as District Director for Congressman Ryan Mackenzie, overseeing constituent services and community outreach.
Paige previously served as Chief of Staff to Ryan Mackenzie during his time as State Representative. In this role, she oversaw constituent services, outreach initiatives, and communications; coordinated the representative's legislative plan; and advised the representative on policy decisions.
She received her undergraduate degrees in History and Government & Political Affairs from Millersville University and earned her Master in Public Administration from Kutztown University.

Julia has known Ryan for over a decade and she recognizes he is among a new generation of leaders that America needs to get the country back on track. Peter, I hope you’ve been enjoying a restful holiday season! With the new year only hours away, I’m reflecting on how much we accomplished in 2024: ✍️ Signed my **comprehensive housing production** bill into law — my #1 top priority and the only bill I introduced in this year’s legislative session. Oregon communities need a menu of new tools and supports to increase our housing supply. 🚨Declared a 90-day **state of emergency on fentanyl** in downtown Portland, which dramatically increased coordination between government and community partners, increased the distribution of overdose-reversal medication throughout the city, and improved safety and livability with new lighting, security measures, and crime-preventing strategies. While the work is not done, progress is happening. 🎒Secured funding from the legislature for **summer learning programs** , which helped thousands of Oregon students stay on track during the summer months. 🚌 Visited all nine of Oregon’s **federally recognized Tribal Nations** , meeting with Tribal leaders and community members to hear their concerns, learn about their priorities firsthand, and understand their role in supporting Oregonians in rural communities. 💰 Signed bipartisan **campaign finance reform** legislation into law, establishing future caps on campaign contributions. 💊 **Protected reproductive health care** by replenishing our state’s stockpile of mifepristone to last through the next four years, proactively protecting access to abortion medication in our state. And these are just the highlights! It’s been a busy year, and I expect even more challenges in the new year with the changing political landscape in Washington, D.C. But 2025 also promises new opportunities to make life better for Oregonians — and I won’t let up or get distracted because there’s too much to do. As we close out 2024, I want to take a moment to thank you for standing with True the Vote. Your dedication has been the driving force behind our progress this year. In 2025, the challenges we’ll tackle will require renewed resolve and commitment - and we’re ready for it!

News & Observer: As protesters shout, NC Senate Republicans override Cooper veto of powers-stripping bill [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=123124_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are already assaulting our democracy, Team. Vote suppressors here in North Carolina stripped the incoming governor of power to codify their control before they lose their legislative supermajority, all because they didn't win all the elections they wanted.
Check out what this bill did:
* Transfers the power to appoint members of the State Board of Elections from incoming Gov-elect Josh Stein (D) to incoming State Auditor-elect Dave Boliek (R).

* Restricts the governor's ability to fill judicial vacancies, forcing them to choose from a list provided by the unelected officials of the departing judge's party.

* Removes the seats of two County Superior Court judges (in Wake and Forsyth counties) after those judges repeatedly ruled against suppressive election law changes.

* Prohibits the State Attorney General from participating in lawsuits that would invalidate action by the state Assembly, even in the defense of citizen's rights.

* Reduces the ballot "curing" time -- where ballots with simple mistakes can be corrected by the voter -- from nine days to three.
That's not all -- this bill attacks the roles of the state education superintendent and the lieutenant governor, makes the State Highway Patrol an independent agency that the legislature controls, and more -- but you get the idea. If opponents of voting rights can't win at the ballot box they'll codify their power however else they can .

Before midnight tonight

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ab51c9e73845490c9fb22e43ac845a27&_e=lQmpvUHRXmfhtDH6UUmoahUJX6qARkox3oM-mejUZb_ksGeE5CKUb1wmLoS0Zjo-9QyphzJZnkKb3XH3KXaW56A1Y3LNbzkv8WRGO03Aynb0W2hrcZYPOLtst7R9wCWf_1s0LNQRymhstnuJaY9vqnC_PBSUVHJpCh4jfstthcAymNaW4T4RQZEl-KUCBOHjBzurNpKUFAZ7fF7nbj4RgOBLFgLeEH0O1tdgkH26SyD2Bnqczmjig0XI5XdwoUhbPU0goL9TXvr_WOdWdJQKaOYai7XAk43xlfo4fISId5DkEf01YEM8jZrZboR9BIRkKBtS93vqSJH4PXoi20P8IaX5FjxdklHPdJcywLMJJtn3ur4SViEO0RAusC2IWr83)

Peter,

Today is the last day of 2024. But our work is far from over. And we need your help.

You can be sure that in the critical year ahead, the far-Left will be working harder than ever to undermine the informed patriotism of young Americans.

This is why we at Hillsdale College plan to redouble our efforts in 2025 to reach and teach additional millions of citizens—especially younger Americans—about our nation’s great heritage of liberty.

**[Midnight tonight is the deadline to give your most generous year-end gift to support Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ab51c9e73845490c9fb22e43ac845a27&_e=lQmpvUHRXmfhtDH6UUmoahUJX6qARkox3oM-mejUZb_ksGeE5CKUb1wmLoS0Zjo-9QyphzJZnkKb3XH3KXaW56A1Y3LNbzkv8WRGO03Aynb0W2hrcZYPOLtst7R9wCWf_1s0LNQRymhstnuJaY9vqnC_PBSUVHJpCh4jfstthcAymNaW4T4RQZEl-KUCBOHjBzurNpKUFAZ7fF7nbj4RgOBLFgLeEH0O1tdgkH26SyCsomAj1IlPJLhLz4VZcGDdHiSDi3sSOZViByqVJZ3rCxoFxi69bTl7_s8-RGmgqeqH-Rmofphs4VRFUEPyMw3UiPAy3FNlTGlE9qo4F9Tv-ILtZ3Cql8FTuJLOC0wbW41SpbiOaRQD9praNikkdzsS).**

We still have not reached our **$6,000,000** year-end online fundraising goal.

**Please make a special tax-deductible gift _before midnight tonight_ to help us expand our educational outreach efforts in 2025 through our Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education. **

By helping us reach our goal...

...you will help increase the reach and influence of _Imprimis_ , our free digest of liberty;

...you will support the production and promotion of free online courses on the Constitution, American history, Christianity, and many other topics;

...and you will help launch and support Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 schools nationwide.

**Time is running out.** Please use the secure link below to make your best tax-deductible gift **before midnight tonight.**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ab51c9e73845490c9fb22e43ac845a27&_e=lQmpvUHRXmfhtDH6UUmoahUJX6qARkox3oM-mejUZb_ksGeE5CKUb1wmLoS0Zjo-9QyphzJZnkKb3XH3KXaW56A1Y3LNbzkv8WRGO03Aynb0W2hrcZYPOLtst7R9wCWf_1s0LNQRymhstnuJaY9vqnC_PBSUVHJpCh4jfstthcAymNaW4T4RQZEl-KUCBOHjBzurNpKUFAZ7fF7nbj4RgOBLFgLeEH0O1tdgkH26SyCDexS2mCKf0kIDtl9mTVO5WdmqlEpOFa5mR36tsc0-Xc21tcORHfaDPDKMo8PDVcLr-aYVi6V09qJoceIY6kQNMdL62I6DSqoAeci1pGtZjwkOcUyZYDhl4pHpGrVOkh7OipgviHDe0yjj4AboVWYi)

Because Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny from the government—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans—the College can remain genuinely **independent** and stay true to its 180-year-old mission.

But this means the College’s work is entirely dependent on the generosity of citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Thank you again for your support in 2024. On behalf of all of us at Hillsdale College, I wish you and yours a healthy and prosperous new year.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Let's face it -- 2024 was a long, difficult year. But if you're reading this, you've made it this far!
In 2024, Mesoscale News brought you more than 100 articles and dozens of podcast episodes to keep you current on world events, meeting my promise at the beginning of the year to bring you more frequent and diverse coverage.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dQKtRQoBFX5tIWqN5u8fBqYgosLgAtsXV62wwqzIcpg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=153862889)
Some of the coverage your subscription brought you in 2024 included:
A first look a[t bombshell documents](https://substack.com/redirect/e98a7247-f765-4bc9-8adb-b637d722501d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) made public by[ Boeing whistleblower Ed Pierson](https://substack.com/redirect/71fc3773-dfbd-43a9-b14e-7a951e3ed214?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), plus coverage on other [Whistleblower news and issues](https://substack.com/redirect/df266b2f-962f-4284-a083-d31d9fe8f1ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Including [personalized invitation](https://substack.com/redirect/9a855f9a-1c07-47c4-9140-6fded1c67434?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)s to the sneak-peak showing of the documentary about my story in Florida)
Project 2025 plans regarding [NOAA a](https://substack.com/redirect/528f9db7-bb02-4d91-a739-8349f21067e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)nd our national weather and climate agencies
Expert review of[ tracking deaths in Palestine](https://substack.com/redirect/f727d548-3405-4018-9080-e0bc32ea9e94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Early reporting on the death of an[ Oklahoma student](https://substack.com/redirect/add9d724-5526-4884-b542-dc3cd83b542b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) attacked for being LGBT
Florida's [elections,](https://substack.com/redirect/5c07cb94-f5f8-4933-9534-61419798f89e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [politicians](https://substack.com/redirect/984ea3ef-1007-45eb-8f58-33366b107846?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([bad guys on both sides](https://substack.com/redirect/6eac2de4-612d-49f1-807c-64208030953f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and[ insider breaking news](https://substack.com/redirect/e41e5456-a082-43bc-84d6-4e84d2797c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Spotlights on key issues and data sets, including: [Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women](https://substack.com/redirect/607013c1-3efe-42fd-9e63-edef051fedf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [H5N1](https://substack.com/redirect/7f4c23b3-71bd-4f72-87af-46071ecf3102?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [measles](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce3ba57-b3ff-43cb-8543-00d1855ca838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Vibrio vulnificus](https://substack.com/redirect/93fb0a32-650b-4172-af1d-6e22cde7c8c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and more.
Frequent posting about [hurricane season](https://substack.com/redirect/a9970942-fbfa-47dd-b7e9-63e3db31e47a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [storm tracking,](https://substack.com/redirect/26a90922-070c-477f-bfb3-e4f6b4765e17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [climate change](https://substack.com/redirect/11ecc70e-aa36-439a-864e-d7e59d579db4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [breaking disaster news](https://substack.com/redirect/3e495856-8131-4ef3-ae3f-78b1581d59e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and global[ disaster briefs.](https://substack.com/redirect/3fe722bc-9b5f-4197-ae49-ed40e7b25ab4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And of course development in lawsuits against Florida -- both[ for myself ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab1d9c44-8885-49de-ac09-3dcd6fc8db3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and other high-profile cases.
Information from reliable, trustworthy sources will become even more important when the Trump administration takes over in 2025 -- especially when it comes to coverage about natural disasters and climate change.
In 2024, I dedicated 30% of my posts to climate-related news and issues.
As soon as the final 2024 data comes in, I'll be writing analysis and providing data on climate change, disasters, public health and more, covering a disastrous year here and abroad using hard statistics.

I'm looking forward to covering whatever comes next with the same exclusive, unique and sharp analysis you've come to know me for.
Thank you!

Despite all parent's efforts, if their child takes the bait and latches onto a leftist lie......if parents show any opposition, the Left brings down all its might against them.Right now, Illinois is debating a bill that changes the definition of child abuse to include parents who refuse to let their minor children change genders.That is what we're up against.And so, all of us who love God and love our country must work together right now to instill rock-solid, armor of TRUTH into our children so they never fall for the Left's insane lies. If you've heard of Brave Books , you know they're a mission-based company that arms pro-God, pro-American parents and grandparents with quality children’s books that captivate young minds and hearts with lessons in conservative values.Maybe you’ve seen them featured on Fox News for countering the Left's horrible poison. Brave Books fought back by enlisting the help of actor, father, soon-to-be grandad, and Christian Kirk Cameron (Growing Pains, Left Behind, Fireproof) to host family friendly "See You at the Library" events across the country."See you at the Library" events proudly start with the Pledge of Allegiance followed by story time featuring great Brave Books with conservative messages such as: The Test of Lionhood by Kevin Sorbo -- Teaches children that masculinity and bravery are good. The Night the Snow Monster Attacked by General Michael Flynn -- Shows children what it takes to be a good leader. Happy No Snake Day byRiley Gaines -- Encourages children to stand up for the truth. Because You're My Family by Missy Robertson -- Teaches children the importance of family and unconditional Christian love. | | Kirk Cameron himself has authored several Brave Books. But my favorite is Pride Comes Before the Fall which teaches the beauty of humility in the eyes of God. The folks at Brave Books aren’t afraid to confront the "woke" Left head on!That's why when they asked me to partner with them on a book of my own, I jumped at the chance.My Brave Book , inspired in part by my father-in-law, is entitled The Never-Give-Up Pup and it teaches the importance of hard work and perseverance. The Left wants kids lazy and unmotivated so they can control them.In The Never-Give-Up Pup , kids learn how good it feels to put in a hard day’s work and see the results on the other side.Strong kids, brave kids, Godly kids are who Eric and I are trying to raise. And I think you feel the same way. Your gift helps Brave Books create and distribute these powerful lessons to America's children, so they never fall for leftist lies.I believe so much in this great American company and what they're doing for our children and our country that in appreciation of your, I'll send you a copy of The Never-Give-Up Pup as a special "Thank you" from me. Sharing the lessons of The Never-Give-Up Pup with your children or grandchildren is a priceless gift. Or if you prefer, you can donate it to your local library or leave it in the waiting room at your next doctor's appointment so children who aren't growing up in conservative homes can get its message. My fellow conservative, thank you for reading my email today. I feel so blessed to have a small role in fighting for our children and our country and I'm honored to have you on our side.For America and America's Children, | | Lara TrumpWife, Mother, and Author | | | Lara Trump Wife, Mother, and Author | | | P.S. name: Tristan Rader
subject: CANCELED Due To Illness: Tristan Rader's Swearing-In Ceremony
body:
Health and Safety First—Thank You for Your Understanding | |
---
| | | Rep. Rader Public Swearing-in CANCELLED
---
|
---
| Dear , I hope this message finds you well. Unfortunately, I’ve been pretty sick over the past week, and with so many others also feeling under the weather, we’ve made the difficult decision to cancel the public swearing-in event scheduled for January 1. While I was looking forward to celebrating this special moment with all of you, the health and safety of our community must come first. We don’t want to risk spreading illness or making anyone feel worse during this time. Thank you for your understanding and support, and I look forward to celebrating together in other ways soon! Take care and stay healthy, and Happy New Years!! Tristan Rader
